text: Gaming is good at the starting but once you play for a month you will be matched with the players that are double of your power. The players who purchase the latest weapons are the winner and the player who does not purchase anything they just keep loosing. At a point it is very frustrating as you will not be able to play for a minute because the opposite are too strong that they will destroy your mech within seconds. and you will keep loosing and you loose interest

The game was fun to play. But when you grind hard to get some stuff , after getting that you come to know that that mech or weapon is going to receive a nerf. That feels like all efforts are wasted. So I can say that it's a complete waste of time. I am thinking of buying a specific weapon but I'm scared if it receives a nerf then again all my efforts will be for nothing.

The game is nice. but the issue is that of money and players. at first it feels easy and weapons and mechs are cheap.but at tire IV it becomes very costlier and players are also weak at my side. some weapons like pod gun should have costs in credits or it should be cheaper like 1000-2000 A-coins and other weapons should be of 4000-5000 credits

The game's good. Nice graphics, smooth gameplay, etc. But, unfair matchmaking. We have to battle people with legendary weapons and mechs while we are having normal to medium weapons/mechs. Also, reduce the prices of legendary Blueprints and legendary mechs. It'll be really good then. It's too hard to keep up with the Pay To Win players if you are a free to play player. Also, now we don't get promo codes frequently like before. Make the matchmaking more balanced.

Not a good game. It's advertised as a competitive game but its mostly about collecting and showcasing mechs. The devs control how much you win and how much you lose so I really don't see the point of playing a game where skills or strategy or even having good gear doesn't matter at all. If your winning rate is high then the game purposely pits you against impossible odds to lower your winning rate. I remember a time when winning depended on the player and not on the whims of the devs.

Game is nice, but the issue is that you have to pay some money to get good Mechs and Weapons after attaining a certain level. If you don't want to pay to have to collect coins to unlock them. And that would require a lot of time. for an example a Mech costs around 9000 of those coins, and you can collect only 200 coins in a week, so image the time you will take to unlock one Mech. same goes for weapons also. so you can enjoy the game until you reach a certain level. after that it's no good.

The game is good but, we will be attacked by the upgraded mechs Or weapons that are obtained by purchase. Non-purchasers don't get good mechs or weapons. It would be better if this is balanced. The credits that you get after each match is very less compared to other games. Purchasing of battle pass is of no use. Though the mechs energy increases on upgrade, we can't add the higher energy weapons. So, I conclude it as PAY & PLAY game.

I love this game! I've been playing it for years, but I do have a small complaint for the progress path. you used to be able to unlock new items through your EXP. level, but now it's through stars that you get by buying other weapons. my complaint with the weapons, is that is doesn't always register the stars you should be getting when you buy multiple weapons quickly. I also wish you could trade in any unused blueprints for in game resources, such as credits or the much needed A-Coins

This game is the best. But there are two different problems,like other players who have the same issue. One is the cost of weapons and robots are very expensive, another is the opponents who are very strong and impossible to kill because they spend lots of cash. So it is true that without cash your game play experience will be harder and harder. But I like it because of the game play. it has no lags, no glitch and my skills are so good I become MVP multiple times. Trust me it's better.

2 things I'd like to bring to the devs notice is that:- 1. Please decrease the cost of mechs and weapons, or give us a more easier ways to earn credits and A-coins. Because it is too much of a grind to get all that. 2. Also take a look in the match making, because since the last 15 matches, I have been getting opponents that are way too powerful, or buffed. Hence winning and receiving the rewards becomes difficult. Otherwise, it is one the best mech fighting games I have ever played.

I like this game very much. But the game has a lot of issues that I hate too like reward glitch(already recieved but can't get), reload speed :(that I hate too much, due to this it becomes more hard to destroy mechs enemies, sharing referrals not activated, and why we need to change new name using a-coins?Please fix these issues as possible as you can. This game now seems dull due to issues😢😩

The game is very good and I have been playing it since the time when we used to get killshot instead of sling shot and panther instead of puma if you remember that time. But the cost of weapons and mech is very high or so it seems because very earn very little revenue even after getting 13 kills in a game like come on plarium,1300 credits is not sufficient for a player with 13 kills and the crates also drop only about 500 to 600 credits and don't get me started on the A coins. The game is good.

Mech Arena is certainly one of the best robot games that have ever been made. The mechs handle smoothly, the game has good graphics, and has alot of variety of mechs and weapons to once unlocked enjoy there special abilities. The only difficulty about this game is that the developers have made progression a very long process for people who are not willing to pay real money. It's also so much fun to play with other people or to play against other people in any battle mode you choose.

One of the best games I have ever played.In this game the phone doesn't even heat after playing like 10 min . It has never bored me since 2022 . I have a idea , what if there was a comparison section where we can compare mechs, weapons and get the pros and cons . Also before we used to get mechs in the progress path but now we can get with in-game credits,the feedback is that the prices are too high . So if you could make it cheaper would mean a lot

This game is actually a trap for youth. It mentally pressures you to get their mechs and other weapons for your real money. In the beginning it gives you a lot of fun, but as time passes, and after it is sure, it slowly slowly captures your mind. IN BEGINNING THIS GAME IS VERY NICE BUT AFTER FEW DAYS OR MONTHS IT'S MECHS AND WEAPON start getting HANG this frustrated you . So, in my opinion, we should not pay any money for any type of mechs and weapons, and also try to less use or not play

I don't even wanted to rate this game a single star but can't as lowest is 1. I don't know what is hell is with matchmaking in this game. Literally I am a mid player but get opponents like meta and maxed out ones. The bots literally leave every other teammate and target real players. The AI on the game isn't realistic, matchmaking is trash and when I asked for some help to compete with them, the support team started to start their "Fairness" term but not for matchmaking and freaking bot's Aimbot

It is the world best game. I am playing it since the beginning when every mech can own by progress path. But there are some things I don't like, first of all that my game lacking and some time it goes back to home page of my screen but it happens only at the time i am playing games and second that they have removed 2v2 deathmatch and many didn't like it. Hope you understand.

the game is fun, but whatever you do, don't spend money on it. The moment you do it launches you into battles that you are hopelessly outgunned in and everybody one shots you and the only way to play is to buy more and more things to keep up. also, I get that they want to advertise things for people to buy, but it literally has 15 pop ups for their sales everyone you log in. I counted. Scale that back people. I don't want to spend the first 2 minutes I log in clicking off your pop ups!

I used to enjoy this game. In the beginning it was fun and challenging but not impossible to win. But with each new season, stronger weapons come out and the "old ones" become obsolete. So much money spent and someone can kill me in 1 second. Something should be changed with match making. Allowing certain level weapons to compete with certain levels.

This game is a lot of fun. There are a ton of fun mechs, gun, and gamemodes. I think it is much fun. I also do not feel this game is pay to win. But there are also some issues with the game. I think this game has far to many game modes. An real in-game chat would be great as well. And the game can simply feel very sluggish and dull at time, due to awfully slow movement and dull colors. I think a bit of bright eye candy and all of the mechs being faster would go far. Overall very good though.

before you download, just understand that greed has taken over a lot of the game. Everything viable is locked behind paywalls or absurd amounts of credits that can take anywhere from 6 months to years to collect enough. With you able to spend (and I mean spend over $200 a week) than definitely download. It's another buyer friendly game. Howeverz the graphics and visuals are stunning, no lags or freezes, and unlike games like War Robots, Mech arena doesn't follow a release, nerf, repeat cycle.

Solid mech shooter. HEAVY PAY TO WIN. Can't give more than 2 stars simply for the shop bombardment. Every single time you open the app you are hit with 10-15 requests to spend money, zero exaggeration, after every match they are asking you again. It has pushed me away from this game unfortunately. EDIT to Dev response: You aim to not be pay to win? The top weapons and mechs are only acquired with Cash purchases. You say one thing and do something completely different. Definition of shady.

Pay to win, I spent 10 dollars a while ago, and I knew it was bad back than, but now? I can't. The problem has gotten so bad I just can't anymore. The mechs and weapons that are available for purchase are so powerful that my level 7 arcs and level 6 zephyr are near useless. Stay far away from this game if you don't intend on spending eve levels of money on it.

Editing after dev response: HOW the game decides my opponents doesn't matter. I went from winning a few and losing a few to losing 7 of the last 8 matches. I've spent hundreds in the game and want a refund. The new matchmaking for this game is horrible. I'm consistently being matched against players and bots with maxed out everything while my stuff has an average of 5 stars. I cannot win against anything. I won't be spending anything anymore and will probably quit playing if it's not fixed.

Wow! Just wow! I have been playing this game for almost a year now, doing in-game purchases left and right. But now the game can't even past the loading screen, it always crashes. Now I can't play the game, my progress and money now gone to waste, thank you for your stupidity. PS: had done several ways to fix this, but still crashes. Edit: Already created a ticket, still waiting for the response.

I've been playing for about 2 months now and everything was great up until I made my first purchase of a season pass then suddenly I lost 28 out of the next 30 fights due to the extreme amount of bots that were being placed not just on my opponents side but my teammates as well. I wrote several emails and though they admitted to using bots, and promised things are changing, I've noticed in the forums that it's been an ongoing issue for last 2 years, same promises, same issues but no changes

The game has serious flaws. Lots of bugs, and if you report them, the admins just make excuses. Targeting changes from the closest enemy to one in the distance on its own, finishing shots fly wildly on the Viper, and the mech Solice main ability is a joke. It is supposed to keep enemies from locking onto you, not so. Mechs somehow can hide from your radar, zap, and shoot you from behind barriers?? Save your money. The rest you take your chances with.

This game is so unbelievably unbalanced, just now, first battle, I kill 14. I just mowed right through. In the very next battle I could barely even hurt anyone, my whole team over ran in a minute. And then... I get an ad to upgrade my gun for just $40.99. They set you up to lose to sell you more. They don't care about you having a good competitive gaming experience, just buy more. The only competition here is to buy the newest stuff.

I would give it no stars if I could. I started this game and got to 3801 for my hanger. I was just faced with a player that had a hanger strength of 15,784!! I could understand if that was an inventory number but that was a hanger number!! Absolute worst game on the market right now!! I mean this is nothing but rage bait at this point. I would play this again but not until y'all fix the matchmaking. WOULD NOT RECOMMEND. ABSOLUTELY PAY TO WIN!!

I was really surprised at how good this game is! It's like a mobile version of Battlefield 2042. In fact it's almost exactly like it... but with robots and less extras (Unless you pay A LOT of money) which is the only downside. apart from the expense to level up, (there should be an option to level up using experience or skill) this is one of the best games I've found in a long time! Fantastic job devs!

Installed only because the insufferable ads wouldn't stop being spammed, it's another low quality mech fighter. The game was so buggy that it froze up after pressing the buy button, then froze up again on the attach button. Had to re-download the game just to get past that. And now the button to get into games doesn't even work. And on top of that there's nowhere to put the promo codes for the free mechs that they try so hard to get people with. Its a horribly made cash grab. Do not download.

Am a newcomer to the game. At first I was enjoying the gameplay and graphics. Now all of the sudden after purchasing a battle pass. I'm instantly being obliterated within seconds of spacing into the battle arena. Have now lost the last 20 rounds or so consecutively. The match making has paired my weak lineup against heavly armed, loaded players/cheaters/bots in which there is only a one second survivability against them. This game is turning out to be a joke.

I have a platinum trophy in modern warfare 2. I haven't played many games lately but started playing more and this game is awesome! I've been MVP six out of my seven first games! haven't had 2 watch one ad. I have spent about $10 but that's okay but I really didn't need to spend anything! gameplay is awesome even with my slow router. this is how video games are supposed to be! 👍

It was fun, interesting, didn't look bad at the start. Good and great players can easily shine as well. That all stops at Division 7-6 though. You immediately know the "good" player by how they have a unique mech and are one-shotting the whole team. It changes fun to "get MVP so i dont lose points." it just gets worse too. HARD pay to win. impossible to climb now. No actual progression or capability to buy mechs you want unless you spend $$$ Uninstalling.

I've been playing consistently for a couple weeks now. Combining various mech designs and weapon types to suit your own personal style is a wonderful design. I can even run trial battles for nearly everything before getting it. This game feels absolutely incredible. However, the progression format seems intentionally designed to force my in game currency into many options I don't want. The only way to keep up long term is through the many micro transaction options. Hurts to let this one go...

I spent alot on this game (including taxes) since 2022. My account was deleted without any warning. I contacted support, and after acknowledging the issue, they left me waiting for weeks with no updates. now i ask for an update, I get no response. Customer support has been extremely disappointing. I won't spend another dime on this game or any title from this publisher. A simple warning before deleting my account would have prevented all of this.

This is a good game. The first playthrough was fun. But the matchmaking in this game is one of the worst I've experienced. Newer or average players constantly get matched against opponents with significantly stronger mechs, weapons, and pilots, making battles feel completely one-sided. Skill barely matters when the power difference is this huge. If you are a free to play player I won't really recommend this cause this game has become completely pay to win even when you have promo code mechs.

Amazing, completely free to play, insanely generous and fun to play. Games like these make me want to buy. And pay to win players need somewhat of skill to actually win. I am amazed with its gameplay and its tutorial. It gives enough details to understand the game, but not so much the game becomes boring. Keep up the stellar amazing work!

its a good game, i love those graphics and all, but once you get to a higher rank, it will be hard for u to win, i dont know why. And once u reach tier IV in the gear hub (place to buy weapons and mech), you will be shocked on how expensive the mechs and weapons are. Its a huge leap from tier III to IV. I need to grind for 1 month just to get a single weapon. and its really hard for you to get credits in the game. Like, the fastest way to get it is only by daily mission and it only gives u 8k.

This game is really good, you have so many mechs and weapons to choose from, I'd say this is the best robot game ever I just think they should include mechs and weapons in scrapping, I have so many mechs and weapons I'm not using and there is no way to get rid of them. I just don't like seeing them in my inventory, if there was a way to scrap them for maybe like 30% of their original cost, that would be good.

imagine a first person SHOOTER where some idiot devs keep introducing abilities that prevent you from shooting. it's a 3.min match and you spend half of it unable to shoot. and they just introduced ANOTHER mech with similar ability. it's like wearing a straight jacket. and I've played this game everyday for well over a year. Ive spent a couple hundred on it. it used to be fun. but it just keeps getting worse. I wouldn't bother there are plenty of other far better shooters.

The game itself is pretty fun. In order to get the good guns and get far, you're gonna either have to play a LOT, or pay some good money. They have decent deals here and there, but the deals are the biggest downside to this game for me. It's annoying as HECK!!!!, that every time I open the game, I gotta close 20 pop ups about the current deals. If they didn't have THAT, I'd probably give the game 4 stars, cuz it is actually quite a fun game. I've also spent about $100 on it, so I'm a bit biased.

One of the worst games ever made. The devs seem to need game monetization to breathe, and they made sure that you won't even have a glimpse of a chance if you didn't spend at least 200 bucks. When opening the game, you have to click through dozens of annoying offers every single time, and you can't even cancel matches that you started, you just have to sit there a full minute and wait if you want to leave a game you accidentally started.

So this game is getting a 2 * rating because while it is cool it is definitely PAY TO WIN. And not only that but they have also chosen to price gouge players who do spend money on items. The other day my son sent me a screenshot of the pod gun and told me to go get it because it was only like $4 on discount. To my great dismay when I went and looked at my offer for the gun mine was listed at $14 with the same discount a mount. They had jacked up the regular price on my items. Super uncool.

this game is fun for a day. on the 3rd day, when you earn your 5th mech, you are put in matches with people who paid $15-20 for a mech and they are dominating everyone. No more fun to be had. ever! this is now so frustrating I want to burn the developers office to the ground. another problem is the "a coins" are few and far between unless you pay real money for them. so upgrading to keep up is out of the question. no external ads, but there are plenty of in game ads to slow it all down.

Honestly, this game would be awesome if it would stop crashing the first 20 times I try to play it. It would also be nice if the pop-up ads were at least all the same size and location on the screen so I don't accidentally leave the game for the play store and cause it to crash again. Edit: They fixed the crashing issues, less pop-ups upon startup, and rebalanced their in-game power scaling and economy. a solid 10/10 game

I've been playing for a year, 9 months of that has been almost daily. The old tournament mode with leader boards was addictive, and they changed it to be less dramatic, as your over ranking is all you have to show now. Still, a fun game that rewards hard playing free to play players who stick in there. I won the current meta mech by spinning a crate for it with a token i had earned through accomplishments. The match-making is tough at times, especially mid game, most opps. are bots then. u

This could be a 4 star game. But the pay to win can drain the fun instantly. Yes as the developers reply says there are ways to progress on f2p, but that is to keep you interested to be fodder for the high paying players that just want to pay to have a "you win" button vs competing. They even advertise their most expensive mechs as being unstoppable. It's a shame, as the mechanics are pretty good, but there is intentionally no balance.

I really like this game, and I would play it more, but the problem is the power creeping situation. it's absolutely terrible, when ever I log on it instantly showers me with at least 5 money offers for a legendary weapon for 100 dollar which is way to much for something that you can get for free plus the fact that if you dont have anything legendary your can really progress. I hope Plarium can fix the game and make it less pay to win friendly and more free to play friendly.

I'm a traditional kinda game player I want to work for my upgrades progress through the levels and get better at the game as I go. Lately I can't get anywhere, out gunned, killed as soon as I spawn, ganged up on by the whole other team, targeted on the field. You must win to get awards that help you advance. I have low level mechs with low level weapons and I'm fighting maxed out max level mechs with maxed out max level weapons. Just lost a match 5 mechs some never even moved before dying.

I play this on my pc and I'm good I think. thanks to Bluetooth on my phone and pc, I have 2 versions I can play, it's just a slightly different HUD. I love the game as much as I loved Splitgate 1 and 2, very responsive screen control, players instead of bots, awesome upgrade tables and weapons, and each mech feels different if you play it on a 32"+ TV like I do. we need more games like this, Plarium, keep up the great work.

I would put 2 and a half if I could it's a good game with good concepts but it's pay to win, with TERRIBLE matchmaking, terrible odds in crates, terrible tournaments (they are getting buffed again but still) not new user friendly, and it seems reports go nowhere because I've played with this same guy for like 3 weeks ALWAYS on the OPPOSITE team, and his stuff is way better than mine. if you want to know my score for reference, im around 4.3k in my load out. also get burnt out after 2 matches....

might be a fun game if everything wasn't stacked for purchase. It is extremely obvious to someone over the age of 10, teams get stacked with players that pay, and teams get stacked with people that don't pay. Makes the game 100% no fun, unless you want to dump a bunch of money in it. Way to take a good game and ruin it by requiring money for it to be fun. And don't try to say skill is involved. if that was true then you could easily separate paying and non paying customers.

This game will conveniently kick you out of matches & lag likewise at the most convenient times. There's no problem with connection here so I know it's game. It's bot ran which has me coming across the most unrealistic gameplay, but it is addicting. The game however does cheat & is super stingy with rewards. Even with maximum upgrade I find weapons don't work for me as they do against me. Overall, fun but annoying.

This game has been ruined by excessive cheating. Just lost like 20 games in a row and was unrealisticly wiped out way too fast. When you see the killcampov they will have sometimes 1 weapon and level 1 with low damage and just trot through the map and level everyone. This takes 100% of the fun out the game and it's now ruined. Uninstalled. Trash.

The game is great but the servers are rubbish... it constantly freezes and says no connection leave match even when I'm connected to WiFi with fast Internet connection... either the servers are being overloaded or people are using cheats because you only have to do a quick Google search to see its a common problem that loads of people are experiencing so... its a shame because the game is good but its getting to the point that its not worth playing because of the constant loss of connection 😕

EDIT: To clarify (since the developers won't): it's free to PLAY, but pay to WIN (so free-to-lose). ORIGINAL: -1⭐ for an unskippable tutorial (which forces you through multiple battles without letting you explore settings). -1⭐ for having 5+ "BUY NOW" pop-ups as soon as you open the app. -1⭐ for being HEAVILY pay-to-win ($20-$100 for equipment). Look, the game itself is pretty fun. Reminds me of Halo and Unreal Tournament. But the number of pop-ups and being free-to-lose is off-putting.

Yes it is a nice game. But I think it is a games in which there are not totally all real players there r many bots cause I again and again see same name players. When u go to higher levels u r not at all able to win. But it is a skill game and a nice game but you have to really struggle hard to become a pro. It is even a nice game as now u dont get any other nice mech games. Good graphics good sfx and good system Not really bad game 😊

Its fun, good graphics, multiple maps, plenty of daily missions. But it has its problems, of course its money driven, but what isn't these days? That's why 3 star. But you can just login everyday and get free rewards so you'll still level up without spending money. Its available in mistplay as well.

one of the best games I ever played not only the game but also the feedback system of plarium is also good I also wanted to add one thing could you pls fix the match making in lover divisions like 4 and 3 and also if possible reduce the price of a coins for buying weapons because to get like 7000 or 8000 a coins without spending money is impossible other than this it is the best game ever

Excellent graphics and good game play. But EXTREMELY Pay to win.Too much rigging in the game.You get the lowest possible prices all the time and the game always to lags when opponents are near you or your close to winning. It has become more frustrating and always 1 vs 9. Your team mates gang up to loose and all ur opponents target ONLY YOU. If you like to be frustrated with overpowered opponents and obvious team mates that throw games download.

not bad but a lot of ads! for example: crate for €5 almost useless! and the seeker mech for €156 powerfull but there are much better ways to spend your money. so don't get lured into buying too much or too expensive in game purchases.YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED

The worst game ever made.The game is heavily supportive of players and mechs who have bought equipment and material from them.I have a mech squad power of over 6500 and got defeated by another player with squad power of 6700. He had bought equipment from the game. How many times I attack him he seems to have residual health every time. Also I have a 5g phone with high speed data but every time I attack an enemy the game pauses me saying I have bad network and in the meantime they finish me off.

I've been playing this for quite a while now and I can say the game is good and all but I don't like how repetitive this game is. there's no way to play a normal mode where we can't climb in division and use that opportunity to grind and max out our mech which makes the whole gameplay progression unfair.

not a bad game....they are however rather dastardly in their options packages...you buy the items then you have to buy more stuff to upgrade the items...you rarely get the items needed in drops....so while it's basically a free game to play as soon as you start spending money it becomes a gigantic cash grab...mercenary ads all over the game....so it's best to not spend any money because it just disappears into a black hole that is never filled

Y'all need to change your game no way I'm getting stun locked the entire time by a singular dude weapon knowing that all of my high tier mix died that to that same weapon and you've got to be kidding me with the mix that can jump people are just camping on top of buildings or higher areas where you can't get them and they'll shoot you down with rockets like really like, y'all need a address, this game a little bit better cuz.I'm about high time where i'm done buying stuff or even playing this

been playing about a year. used to be my favorite game . now it's nothing but getting killed on repeat by play to win people. soon as you even log on its 30 pop ups trying to get you to spend money. the objectives are literally view 2 sponsored videos. it's unplayable unless you wanna spend 70 a robot.

Great game, smooth controls, fun battles, and awesome mechs. My only suggestion: please add more game modes. The game is getting more popular and needs more variety. Modes like 1v1, 3v3, unranked matches. I feel free-for-all, and custom games would make it much more fun and keep players playing longer. Overall, I love Mech Arena. More modes would make it even better.

If you got the cash this is the game for you. You can get an legendary mech at a low price at a low rank to play against low ranking mech and destroy them with ease. No skill is involved with this game. Just need the cash. Which is sad. Great game and design but rule by greed. A 5 star or maxed out rare mech is no match for a 3 star legendary mech. Which can cost less then $10. You'll never win again people who pays. So lame!!

this game is so good one of the first games that I have played and also one of the best games i have ever played no bugs no glitches this is just perfect but I have just one request when I was new I got a little frustrated because the energy amount of the mech were lower than most of the weapons so if you can please lower the beginner guns like the uncommon ones just a little it will make it more fun 🙏 🙏

I love the game! However, there are lots of annoying things. First the matchmaking. Lots of bots! If not bots, then you get paired against strong players with legendary hangar but still at low division. Second is the cost of mechs. Quite understandable but still, you need good mechs and weaps asap to go against those smurfing guys. Third is the discount pop-ups every time you start the game. I know the devs are money hungry but this is annoying.

This game is Horrible 😔 Promotes PAY to Win 👎👎(it does give you free stuff but so what, some dudes spend more money get maxed out stuff and boom all your mechs wiped out in seconds) Unfair matchmaking 👎 Network errors 😭 there are more but what can I say I aren't playing it anymore goodbye "but hope they fix it it was fun to play when I started it I don't want it to get ruined just because of some unfixed problems

Hi Dev team, overall a great experience, the gaming modes, tournament, new mech and weapons introduction is amazing. However I have been feeling one thing lacking in the game since many years I have been playing on and off. We should have option for selling/scrapping the mechs and weapons which have become obsolete in our hangar due to level progression. the same would greatly boost resource allocation and provide pilots better opportunity to strategize their hangar. pls include it in next updat

this game is pure pay to win, I am just a newbie, and just started playing for an hour, imagine having a total starter kit then when you started match making you suddenly found your self fighting with those enemies that can one shot you, but you can't upgrade any further because it's too expensive just to upgrade a gun

Great team mech game, what you'd usually expect. There are a lot of rewards for grinding, which is good, but there are an excessive amount of pop ups. The UI gets very cluttered at times and things being displayed over other things. If you want to login for a quick match don't get distracted trying to collect all your stuff. I just had an error. When I reinstalled the game, it wiped all of my data, and I could not find an in-game help option. ((Update)) The issue was resolved. I got back my original account. Be sure you write down your account ID number or know how to access your Google Transaction Codes so you can verify what you had. It took about a day and a half after the ticket was made. There is a bug with the "Collect All" option. DO NOT USE IT. It does not always give you everything, disabling some items...

I downloaded this game just to complete some ad challenges for currency in a different game but I ended up getting hooked on this one. It has plenty of challenges and ways to earn the paid currency. My only issue with the game is the amount of pop up advertisements for their special bundles. Every time you load the game you have to click "X" on about 3-7ish offers just to play, then after a few games more will pop up. I don't mind microtransactions, I just want an option to disable the pop ups.

This is easily the funnest phone game I have. The problem is the disconnect between the company and the players. The ads are out of control. It is pay to win. You could eadily spend 1000 dollars before your me h is even playable... absolutely deplorable. You can spend months upgrading a weapon one level. It takes even longer to get new weapons. Which then takes years to get to a level where you can be competetive. The game play is fun but the leveling up is a nightmare.

This game has a good potential but definitely ruins the initial experience with forced actions at the start. Downloaded the game, opened the game, and for 30 min straight, I'm being forced to do actions without being able to do my own. Tells you what to upgrade , what to buy , what to click on, and you are locked out completely when it comes to doing any other actions until you finish all the things the game wants you to. An ability to skip all that should be added to the game.

There are Way Too Many Ads! It makes me feel like I'm paying to watch an advertisement and that doesn't work for me. Plus, those of us who play Raid Shadow Legends know the pain of 'Pop Ups'. But this game has a minimum of 12, everytime you log in, just to Clear the screen so you can play! That's ridiculous!!! Other than that, I like the gameplay and the mechanics. There aren't too many New Players visiting Earth that don't know how to click the Store/Shop button. ijs Enough already!

Would be a good game if not for the way they went about getting money from players. The prices on things are insane. I don't want to hear what sport games try to charge for players because they are equally insane. The amount of premium shop item adverts at start up and between is overboard. The gameplay mechanics are imbalanced due to the things that they allow high tier mechs to do, map design, and controls. Feel that it needs a rework, but won't likely happen.

The most pay to win game I have ever played. Which is unfortunate, because the gameplay is actually really good. The match making system forces you into matches where it is practically impossible to win. You will be up against players and bots that have that expensive gear. It is clearly designed to encourage you to spend vast amounts. I don't mind paying for a game, but this has excessive pricing. Edit: The "easy to unlock" mechs would be fine and fun to play if you were matched with equals.

Fun and addictive game, if you are willing to shell out ridiculous amounts of money. You can play for free, but your mechs will be taken out instantly. Better weapons are unlocked as you advance, or they can be unlocked early for $60 - $70. Each. 1 weapon. Once you get to the top tier the cheating is just way out of control. Devs act like they control it, but its the computer AI doing the cheating. Not even worth playing anymore when the AI can literally do what they want with no restraints

I do NOT recommend this game. It is a perpetual cycle of bugs and the tearing down of free to play players. With every season they make it harder and less frequent to earn the necessary in-game currency to make progress while consistently coming out with overpriced mechs, equipment and pilots that would take EXTREMELY LONG to get if ever at all. By the time you've acquired the equipment that you've wanted for so long it has been made obsolete in terms of end game use and debuffed to be useless.

It's a great game but a couple things detract from it. 1) pop ups. I shouldn't have to click through literally almost a dozen pop ups just to play the game! Find a way to cut that back so I can get to the action! 2) while the game is free to play, it's also pay to win. I get that you need money to keep the game going, but spending real money to get high end mechs and weapons really throws off the balance of the game and makes it less fun for everyone else.

It's a fun game . But its quickly ruined when you realize a lot of items are only accesible with real cash purchases. And that you have to buy these items later, not to win, but to just be able to compete with others. Tones of sales to try grab ur money. And once they do grab your money. They then make the weapon available to others for in game cash with an update. (fragments). A gun put up for sale only to be made free a few days later. Money hungry scums.

It feels like wasted potential, the gameplay feels great, the movement is smooth, and the different guns and mechs feel different to play, its fast to find a match and the matches are quick and don't feel overextended, but whenever you go to the main screen (which you do alot) you get alot of in game pop ups to buy stuff and you have to close every single one, one at a time, to be able to interact with anything else, you can also buy most things in game with real money which do give more power.

This game reflects society. If you have money you'll be at the tip and win. Skill doesn't matter, money does. Progression without spending money is more time consuming than any other mobile game I've played. You're bombarded with dozens of prompts to pay money for in game items/resources. It all couldn't be more in your face. Opportunity to gather the various coins and mechanics without money are VERY limited. The gameplay and concept are fantastic. The greed of the developers ruins it.

Can't win with this game. It's always one step forward, 3 steps back. Battles used to be enjoyable, now the bots they force you to play against are too overpowered that your only option is to spend money to get better. But there lies the problem, as they are super eager to ramp up the difficulty just as soon as you do. Never ending chase, not the game it used to be a year ago.

It's a pretty good game in terms of gameplay but with quite a few negatives… I grinded VERY hard for two of the weapons, which they just NERFED. A 5-star legendary weapon dealing 900 damage at 100 meters?!? It used to deal at least 5k. Not to mention the infinite pop-up ads. I just logged back on for the first time in a while, and my free-to-play hangar now sucks because they are focused on money, not making the game more fun. Unless the devs fix this, this game is just not for me anymore.

best game eva Edit:The game is still great, but could you reduce the pop up adds. I see someone's pissed off about it 😂. You can make it like "more offers at bla bla bla" or just combine multiple ads into one screen. It's still promoting to anyone who wants to buy but also it would be less annoying for someone that is F2P (free 2 play), which means they don't want to buy anything with real money.

It's a great great game. Belive it or not, I don't consider it "pay to progress" because there is no progression. You start off with weak mechs fighting other weak mechs. Then if you want, you can crank up the power to fight other equally strong mechs. The game is thirsty for your money, you can tell by all the ads and awards for spending real money, but if you don't wanna buy anything, you can still enjoy the game as is.

overall the experience is good. Liked the graphics and all but the thing is, this game is not about having skills to play the game even if you are a skilled player, It's more about having a lot of money to buy weapons and upgrades. There are no match making based on weapons/stats/ so if you stumbled upon a group of overpowered players that's way out of your league, you just gotta' enjoy that screenplay of the other team destroying your team and losing the battle 👌

I have played this game for a couple of years now, and there is always this one issue everywhere, and that is buyers. One example of this is there was a tournament going on that if you were top 3, you get the new hemlock. In the end, in like when there were 12 hours or less left, a buyer takes 3rd place away from me. I spent everything I had to become 3rd, and a buyer can take it no problem. I'll ask if you could make a separate server for buyers or give us even more Acoins to stand a chance.

With decent graphics, a few different maps, and 3 modes, the game has some potential. Played for a few months now and it just feels like more and more of a cash grab. Almost every event you have to spend money to finish. Any event with other players can be won by purchasing enough of their "A-Coins". At their rate of giving you the premium currency it would require 3-4 years to have one maxed hangar (70000+ A-Coins). Good luck getting to anything else you might want to try after that..

Where's the actual "PvP", when 95% of the "players" are AI bots? Why do I get like 20 pop ups telling me to buy stuff every time I open up the game? Why the "limited" time offers never expire and stay at 4 min mark? The game is very generous with rewards at first, but after some time the loot becomes so redundant that either you'll have to spend years grinding or spend money. Meanwhile you're going to get bombarded with more pop ups to spend money for every resource you're lacking at the moment.

Great game, the gameplay is fantastic, the weapons are cool and the sound effects are pretty sweet too. I've spent a little bit of money in this game, and it's reassuring to see others in the reviews commenting on how sales heavy the game is. I've bought a Carbine and some A coins but the prices for everything else simply put me off, and the amount of clicks you have to do each time you log on is annoying. I appreciate developers need to make money, but this seems greedy is now pushing me away.

The game was fun so far. The bad review is only and really only because of the pop ups. Start game = 8 pop ups. 8!!!!! End a match = 2-3 pop ups, come back from a menu = pop ups. Are you guys mad? I start the game and get annoyed immediatly, who wants to play like this? Id even much rather buy if there were no pop ups and you just convince me with gameplay and a once in a while deal. But this, this is the equivalent of a store where the salesman wont leave you alone, despite asking for it.

Ruined the game by adding mechs that have special ability to freeze you/Disable weapons. The freeze duration is so long you are guaranteed to be killed. The kill is so easy now and no skill required anymore. Just pay for these two type of mechs and you will win every game. Second issue is the constant pop ups asking buy this, buy that. How about you move this to the bottom shop rather then spamming people to buy things. Is someone wants to buy more coins or a mech they can make the decision.

From a gameplay aspect this game is a LOT of fun. HOWEVER, it is P2W. Over half the weapons are locked behind premium currency or pay walls. You can obtain premium currency through challenges, but not a lot. The other issue I have is the ABSURD amount of in game pop-ups for weapons, mechs, or pilots. Like 10 of them when launching and e or 4 after each match. And pretty much all of them are pay to obtain items. It's damn near impossible to play as a free player. It's unfortunate.

This game used to be fun. Now they have added so much stuff to it, it is so unbalanced. Also this game is only fun for those who have money to piss away, this is one of the worse cases of a pay to win app that I've encountered. There are also a lot of bots and hackers that make the game unwinnable and the developers refuse to do anything about it. Also their so called "deals" are way too expensive. I've also noticed if I purchase a new weapon, it only comes with one side and not both.

Great game. This is P2W but not in the way that you get stomped by someone paying more. What you get from paying is faster progress. Not sure how it is at end game, there might be more advantages. But if you play F2P you can still get all the stuff, it only takes longer. That's where the core of the game shines. The gameplay is really good. Pace yourself and play more games in low level, its still fun and the match making is pretty good at keeping a fair level, on the mechs. Skill is up to you.

This is not a free game. Unless you pay, progressing is slow and nearly impossible. Newer mechs and weapons are overpowered, and, unless you're very lucky and happen to randomly end up in a good team, prepare to get slaughtered. There appears to be no mechanism in place to match you with players your own level. In-game weapons are over-priced, and it takes forever to generate in-game currencies (especially the A-coins). It used to be fun, but now free players don't stand a chance.

TOO MANY POP UP PURCHASE OFFERS. 8-12 everytime you open the game. Put them in a tab!! A vast majority of the content is behind a pay wall. Of course everything is available to purchase with credits and credits are obtainable through natural progression..if you have 750 years to play. Many mechs and many weapons are only obtainable in a reasonable sense by in-game purchases which is a huge put down. No doubt; spending money = huge advantage.

Don't waste your time playing this game. This game has become heavy pay-to-win. It constantly bombards you with transactions whenever you first open the game. The game puts you in matches where you are underpowered and underequipped to incentive paying to be able to have fun and play. Because of this the game has died out, with many matches filled with many many bots (which will be more poweful than your mechs). I played this game since its release, and due to greed the game has become bad...

Money grubbing devs ruin otherwise good game. Everytime you open the app you will be greeted by somewhere between 3 and 12 "exclusive offers" to pay real money for in game items. Having a rough time? Throw some real money at the problem. And the business model itself is great as long as it can keep its sheepy player base interested in the newest mech and weapons (sold separately by the way). I would rather deal with ads.

This game been able to keep my attention despite being a pay-to-win/advance game. It will take you an extremely long time to advance your mechanics and weapons without paying and some weapons, mechs, and pilots will be out of reach for you. If you do tend to pay, be ready to pay. Some items may cost as little as $2.99 or upwards of $80.00. All in all it is a fun game to play as the battles are short a sometimes quick.

it's a really fun game that has the potential to be one of the best. however the disappointing paid to play, not WIN, but to hold your own in the upper leagues the pay to play scheme is pretty heavy-handed. and that being the case, a lack of an easily accessible purchase history is just unexcusable. being told by customer support that I need to provide more information on the transaction when it was my only1 of type or was my last one out of my whole 20 of them is absurd. 5*otherwise.

Gameplay is very fun. There is is a lot of potential for skilled gameplay but its just not there yet. This game is very unbalanced. Some weapons are super good and some are very bad. The same can be said about the mechs. I personally only spent a total of $5 and was content with my mechs. But as others have said this game can be very pay2win in some lobbies.

Great visuals. Easy to pick up controls. I men hey giant robots fighting its cool........would be great if I could join a match. Wait time says 15 seconds max more like I'm sitting there for 5 minutes. Would love to play. If it doesn't get fixed I'll just Uninstall. Pity. Edit: so apparently you need to be on wifi to play. Even if you're playing with 5g and with full bars of service it won't let you play unless you're on wifi. Shouldn't have to be like that I truly enjoy this game.

Waste of time money pit. Constantly trying to get you to spend money. Mechs that teleport,ones that crash and kill you but suffer no damage,smh must have been created by 8yr olds. $100 mechs and weapons, prices are ridiculous and greedy. When you buy something they level you up so the purchase was useless to try and get you to buy something else. Don't waste your time or money because that's all this game is, a waste...

Need to further improve this game. Always encounter the same enemy repeatedly after losing a battle, not fair at all! The enemy has more powerful weapons than our team. Rocket Montar? Arc Torrent? ARE YOU KIDDING? I didn't have time to dodge, and die already. Just throw away those weapons. Or please, nerf the weapons' damage and i will change my review. Also the invitation thingy takes a long time, need to fix friends' status (on/offline) sometimes it keeps saying my friend didn't online.

Not to spend on. Unbalanced. Unclear purchases (Weapons in sets but when you purchase, you get only one until you upgrade. The upgrades for the weapons costs more than twice as much as the initial cost to upgrade to get the second weapon) Some weapons are basically wallhacks, ofc it's the paid ones. Bots will only target you if you're the only human player on the team. Even if they're already engaged in another fight. Unbalanced

Done a few battles, had a blast and even got MVP on some. I started getting into it, now every time I try to start a new battle, it pops up a Internet Connection loss message. which is weird. I been using wifi, and have a full strength signal. And now the app is unexpectedly closing mid battle. This game could be fun if it functioned properly. I restarted the app, and was able to resume my battle, but this shouldn't be happening in the first place! This game could be so fun if it just worked!

After logging in (not for the first time), you're greeted with, and I'm not exaggerating, 13 consecutive ads for in app purchases. 13 pop ups in a row. That's absolutely insane, and I will be uninstalling immediately. EDIT: If players are interested in making purchases or checking deals, they'll go to the shop. No justification for FIFTEEN ads in a row. Take the time you use designing ads and put it towards game development, you'll make more money in the long run.

Fun but..... This is a great game. However it is highly unbalanced. If you want to compete seriously you have to pay. And once you have your mechs, weapons and pilots to a certain level, you will have to pay just to advance them. Or spend months saving up just to level up. The prices are ridiculous. The devs have created a great game. But clearly want you to pay to play.

At higher tiers, you only play with mindless bots in your team, that do nothing more than give free points to the enemy team. You end up racking 80% of the team kills, but (maybe) win the match with a point difference of just 1 kill. This is pretty standard for this genre. There's nothing new here, I'm moving on. Came back to the game after ba year, and the matchmaking is worse than before, and instead the devs want to focus on adding new weapons and skins.

Graphics and gameplay are good, pvp is trash. I've been playing this game for a few years. It was good, fun, then it just became unplayable. The opponents have at least 1k, most cases double, triple, quadruple your "power" level. I nerfed my team to barebone, after many attempts found a middle ground, that lasted less than a week. The game heavily depends on paying to win. Keep in mind, the higher your power level, the higher your opponents will be. uninstall, it it's not even fun to play anymor

Extremely invasive pop ups. As soon as you open the game, around 10 pop up offers invade you (not an exaggeration). If you close the app and want to play again after a few minutes, you have to go through the same ordeal. I understand they need to make money but this is just TOO MUCH. It ruins the experience and makes me want to stop playing at all. Horrible! Edit: At least implement a pop-up setting to turn them on/off

There is a weapon called the Disc Launcher that recently released. It's one of the strongest weapons in the game and regularly dominates matches. It first released in a random loot box table that you could spin for 500 premium currency ($5 USD). The chance to get it started at 1/15 and got higher as you eliminated different rewards on the table, potentially costing $75. That event ended and now the only way to get it is to spend $70. This is the most shameless example of pay2win I've ever seen

It's impossible to make any progress without spending money. Seems in most matches, one team is ridiculously overpowered by the opposing team and is massacred in less than 30 seconds. It is very apparent that to hold your own in this game, you'll have to regularly shell out money. Reading through all of the reviews, I noticed most (if not all) of the responses made by Mech Arena seem to be autogenerated. Shows a lack of caring. Which is unfortunate because the game is very fun to play!

Honestly, a fun game ruined by predatory mechanics. I could ignore just how pay to win it was, if it wasn't for the constant pop-ups. Every time you log in you need to close between 5 and 7 "flash sales". Every single time. Actually writing this I'm lowering my review to one star. They're incredibly annoying and they make something that should be quick and easy into something annoying and tedious.

The game is a money trap. It really is a fun game but the better weapons and mechs are so expensive to aquire that they just cannot be acquired practically unless you sink a lot of money into the game, the cost to acquire the items with the in-game currency outstrips your ability to acquire said in-game currency. I will still play the game but I am encountering more and more people who sink a lot of money into the game and it is starting to lose its appeal

I have greatly enjoyed the game for the first 2 or so years, but now with all the new weapons only obtainable if you spend money being so overpowered (*cough* EM Rifle *cough*), those who spend that money gain an unfair advantage over other players like myself who are just trying to do the best with what we have. That's not even touching on those who use cheats in Tournaments like aim-assist on snipers and penetrating through obstacles and walls. It's hard to find a fair match nowadays.

Good game. It is fun to play. My only critique is that matchmaking is a bit out of balance at times do to pay upgrades, but it is still a fun game. 2 years later, and the matchmaking is worse than before. The pay to win is out of control and you don't stand a chance, unless you are willing to spend $99.00 per mech, not including upgrades and purchasing premium weapons. I've uninstalled, and deleted all account data. Edit: Too many people have been saying the same thing, you are not genuine.

It is seriously a good game, but incredibly Pay-To-Win.. You only get 1 pilot for free, but if you want more you either have to sacrifice ALL the credits you have gathered for 1 other pilot that's specific to a play style. The weapons you "unlocked", you still have to buy them with credits OR coins. They say they offer a lot of ingame currency to free-to-play players but it isn't enough. you still have to grind while fighting other players who paid for their mechs, weapons & pilots.. SAD

Insane amount of pops when you launch the game. There is so much pressure for you to buy their goshdarn offers. First of all, Don't. And Second, The game is a grind fest. It is fun and the gameplay is top notch, but i feel like they want you to pay to win instead of just playing for days on end. What a shame, cause this game is very well done otherwise. Controller support is better than most app I've seen out there

This game used to be fun, man. It was a blast to play, and you'd get matched with people who had mechs that were about as strong as yours. But now, if you don't pay, you're pretty much screwed. As soon as the match starts, some dude with an almost maxed-out mech and a gun that deals like 40,000 dmg per shot just starts blasting everyone. And then they just keep killing you every time you respawn. After the match, you find out that the only way to get the gun is to buy it from the shop. It's sad

This was fun. Then all the sudden everyone is playing killshot with a javelin rocket... They just spawn run and shoot rockets from across the map. Once you get higher it is IMPOSSIBLE to play without paying. You will never get any weapons, sure you "unlock" them. But then you have to use one of like 7 in game currency to buy the weapon. 250k and you make maybe 500 credits to 2k credits a match? Sure that'll happen quick! Better not want to use many weapons! Just spawn a mech without weapons!

The game was awesome at first. Less ads and good players. Over time, ads became worse. Even after completing viewing the ads, you can't close them to proceed. Have to restart the app. There is always a cheater in the game set. I can't remember a game play where there is no cheater playing. I love the game it is such a waste that it got worse over time.

If everyone is telling you "remove the annoying pop ups" and you keep saying "the players need to see the pop ups or they might miss in game events" it only sounds like you're saying "the push notification pop ups are a great way to remind players to spend money" it's annoying. Stop. I'm not playing this game if that's how you're going to be. Reading developer replies to reviews is the fastest way to see how manipulative a company is.

Let me first say, this game is better than war robots. It's a great experience until you start hitting the wall where you encounter the insane Pay-to-Win players and can't get out of your spawn. I made it that far and deleted the game after about 30 games in a row exactly as described above... So I suppose my search for a mobile game worthy of my dedication continues, unfortunately.

Fun for a day or two. But is ABSOLUTELY a PAY TO WIN app. You can spend months grinding, but you will NEVER be as good as someone who spends their parents' money to buy upgrades. It's sad, there is alot of potential to be a good game, if it wasn't pay to win. Oh and let's not forget the pop-ups for bundles EVERY TIME you log in to the app. No less than 10 of them.

This game could have been amazing. Instead the developers ruined it by: 1. Restrictions on gaining XP and battle points. There is a daily limit to how much you can earn 2. It becomes exponentially harder to upgrade your bots the further you progress without paying, so if you are not willing to spend some serious coin, this game may not be for you. The list goes on, I just can't fit all of it here.

I would have given this game four stars because it's a solid game. The only problem... it's pay to win. They monetize this game in every way possible (ads, merchandise, and in-app purchases). But the problem is that some in app purchases are shop exclusive mechs that are overpowered, which makes this game pay to win, which is a shame because it's a great game with good controls and mechanics, but pay to win players ruin the whole experience for everyone.

To be honest, it's truly a fun game. My issue with the game was in purchasing and support. If you'll play the game for free I recommend it, if you are planning on purchasing anything just realise that you may not receive what you purchase, and they will change it to other in-game currency. Also when you reach out to the support you'll get an automated message but then no message for usually 2 days, which puts you outside of the Google return policy, and can screw you on returning the purchase.

The game itself is fun, but I was really hoping for more like a world of tanks blitz in that paying for things didn't mean you had better things, just different/unique. But you are limited to how far you can progress each day all while getting obliterated by people with much higher level weapons. It was fun while it lasted Edit: their solution, read discord. Come on. Pay to speed up progression, great I'll do that, but not pay to win.

I enjoy the game overall, however, it's basically like every other game. If you're free to play enjoy the fun, competitive matches while you can. Eventually you'll face players with mechs that have 150k health compared to your 15-45k with weapons that can kill you with 1 shot before you get in range of your weapons or it'll take 5+ mags to do any damage. You'll also die within 5 seconds of spawning and lose 100-20 when facing those players. Can be fun if you can live with all that.

Game is real fun, even though it's a total Walking War Robots ripoff (literally same mechs, same levels). A few popups on start and after matches wasn't too bad. However, after I bought the battle pass I now get 20+popups every time. Literally sale ads for each increment of credits and a-bucks. Don't wanna buy 200 bucks? How about 400? No? How about 800? God I wish I never purchased anything. 0/10 would refund if I could.

Very pay to win. Do not recommend unless you're going to spend money. Grind is very long. After spending 50$ I have surpassed many elites and beta testers. I have met several who have just blown 500$. Also, player base is VEEERRRRRYYYYY TOXIC. it's as if the entirety of 4chan is on here. Disgusting people. Overall just a joy-sucking game. It's released, but in it's current state, I'd think it is still in beta testing. Too many things need to be added or fixed.

Pretty fun but VERY pay to win. They will also jam (depending on the hour) between 10 and 20 "BUY THIS!!" popups on your screen every time you launch the game that you have to close one at a time after an animation before you're allowed to actually get to the main menu. Really wish this was run by a better company. Response edit: I'm actually a paying player. I understand studios need to make money. You guys just took it way too far. And do you really think 12 popups EVERY launch is good?

I've played a variety of games on PS4, PC,& mobile, bt dis one stands out as d absolute worst gaming experience I've ever had. It's clearly not designed for serious gamers, as there is a total lack of consistency. I've been giving feedback for nearly a year, yet I've seen barely any improvement. D game seems engineered to make you spend money, & once you do, you'll be matched with players possessin significantly higher power, while your team's bots end up being ineffective. Stay away!

Do not jump for the $99 weapons. They end up coming out later on for way cheaper. They do this to move in the next $99 weapon. Let's be honest, their ideas are getting worse and worse. The last few mech and weapon combos they came out with are laughable at best and next to no one uses them. Pocket your money and catch things on sale. I've seen a lot of weapons drop down to $14. Not a good game to be impulsive in.

Fun game, looks good, runs good but it's the single biggest pay to win game I've ever played. After a certain point if you don't have a team of 5 mechs with exclusive weapons that you buy(which are just better versions of the free ones) you can't compete. They try to lie to you with weekly drawings but every one is rigged so that you have to use thousands of coins before you get one of those weapons or mechs.

I can't give this game a high review, I like it, it's fun and competitive. But I have 2 pet peeves about it. 1) It's pay to win, a newcomer can play better than you simply cause he's rich and maxed out his mechs in hours. 2) Too many pop ups, logging into the game you'll immediately see 20 pop ups and there's no option to avoid them, you can press events in between pop ups but it'll still be there. But overall, still a fun game that I can enjoy in my free time.

The gameplay itself is good. Some serious balance issues (Why can you one shot other players with artillery/lock-on missiles.) But the main issue is how this game will throw ads in your face to try and make you spend money. Buy a new weapon? Get a popup saying 'HEY YOU KNOW WE SELL A BOOSTER PACK FOR THAT WEAPON'. Buy a new mech? 'HEY YOU KNOW WE SELL A BOOSTER PACK FOR THAT MECH'. After just about every single match you play the game will spam you with popups that you have to close trying to get your money. I have had to close up to 10 popups just to be able to reque and play another match. Oh and good luck being competitive without spending money. The sheer amount of RNG this game requires just to be able to upgrade mechs and weapons is ridiculous. You open crates and from those crates you HOPE that you get the 'pieces' of the mech or weapon you want to upgrade and the more you upgrade the more and more of these you have to find. And there are not only levels, but ranks, and it costs the premium currency to upgrade ranks. Which this game gives you in an absolute trickle. It took me a few days of doing every event I possibly could to save up enough to unlock a fairly low tier artillery weapon, only to find out that I absolutely hate it. Fun game design right? Now there's another weapon I want and it'll take a few days just to unlock that. IS it good or fun to play? Who knows, I'll have to grind it out and unlock it to find out. And then if it is good, spend the next few months farming RNG to upgrade it. FUN. All in all this isn't a bad game. The gameplay is honestly pretty solid, even if it could use a few balance updates. What gives this game such a low rating for me is how they shove monetization in your face, and make it near-impossible to progress without spending money.

It's frustrating; I invested in upgrading my favorite weapons, only to have them significantly weakened. I'm uninstalling because this game caters more to those willing to spend large sums of money rather than average players looking to enjoy gaming. DISGUSTING!!!

Very fun. You can progress through the game in a slow but still fun way. Large variety of playstyle for your mech. If you like slow and tough, there is a mech for that. Glitch Arena. Single play is awful, I believe it's mostly bot play because mechs run in circles and won't defend when engaged in fire fight. Most games feel like 5v1. This game is awesome. It's fun till you reach a certain point. Gameplay is quick, easy controlls, all around a great game to play fast matches or break up the monotony of other mobile games. However, I gave this game 3 stars because it's pay to win. Bravo on the creators of making an addicting game with enticing pricing. There is no balance between mechs and weapons. The pay to win mechs and weapons have 0 strategy.

Never had I ever felt genuine rage in a game before. No matter how hard you try, free-to-play players are constantly "one up-ed" by a random dude with some cash to spend. Lagging gameplay, mismatched/overpowered teams, and a constant plethora of IN GAME ADS to constantly remind you that if you want to win a game, you must spend real money. 1 star

To be honest.. I've had better... And if you've played Mech Arena then chances are you have to. This is a great game. great developers, as an indie dev, I respect them a lot. but what absolutely ruins it for me, is the excessive pay to win, to the point where if someone spends like 30 bucks, nobody else in the lobby will win. also, opening up to 30 ads that I cant quick close, really sucks. great game, but they ruined an amazing opportunity. and, even though almost every 1 star review is about the game being pay to win, they aren't going to do anything about it. sadly, all they want is 💰.

Absolutely wonderful game. I really enjoyed playing as It has so much potential but unfortunately falls short of 5 stars. I LOVE THIS GAME!!!! If I could meet the dev, I'd literally give them a box of chocolates. This game has everything, it's balanced, and has optional in-app purchases. I've played this game for probably over 500 hours now. Haven't spent any money on it, but it is very discouraging that you put time limited quests. Intense and fun when you have the right load out. The Pros: graphics are good, controls good and customizable, the pilot addition is a good new component to the game, plenty of events to collect mechs, weapons, etc. The Cons: player match-up is not good (frequently playing against others three divisions higher and double the squad power), the pay to win factor is way out of hand, need to make credits/A coins easier to collect/receive, how are you supposed to complete tasks with weapons that are impossible to get/no way to get more tokens?

Way too many ads. In addition to that, the game is totally pay to win. Game isn't fun with all the players that buy everything, and it's all to expensive to begin with.

This is a great game but as others have said, Pay to win is a huge problem in this game. I strongly think that there should be a ranking system even in control point or even power level groups. The game has good graphics and gameplay. However, it is a pay to play in my opinion. If you can't afford the best mech and guns then you are at a disadvantage. Call of Duty, I can have a zero attachment build and beat a 5 attachment meta build. It has more to do with skill. This game you can buy the best mech and guns and beat anyone that doesn't have the money to spend or chooses not too.

I love this game... I have been playing for 2 and a half years. Just recently it has started to shut down on me. When I start a battle(mostly tournaments and 5v5) my screen freezes. I have become very frustrated because I will be halfway through a game and it freezes up on me and to unfreeze it I have to leave the game.

This game was fun before it went to pay to win. It had good potential but first issue I had is that you can't freely costimize your controls, it has to stay in a pre-determined area of the screen. It just made playing much more uncomfortable. It's a very fun game with lots of customizable mechs for battle. The only thing that I would say is bad with this game is the prices of the items. The token prices for events are way to expensive, but if you wait a couple weeks the same mech or weapon that was in the event might be on sale for only a couple bucks; but, at a lower level. Even with the prices, it's still a great game.

Overall game: Good Competitively: so much, the game keeps getting harder like any other game but when it comes to much making the more you spend the better you bots and weapons for you. Pros: Very high production value, excellent graphics with smooth and tight game play, for the most part. New content added and weekly events. Made with much care. Cons: While the first few upgrades are free, the upper level mechs weapons are ridiculously overpriced. $60+ for a gun? The price of a full retail PC game? Who made that decision? Saving up for it with in-game credits will take months. And for the few who do purchase them, they are incredibly overpowered and game-breaking.

Fun game but CONSTANTLY like literally daily needs you to delete apps/files to create more room for it because its constantly requiring more space on your device.
