They deleted my last review, so here is another. This game used to be fun. Matchmaking is insanely broken. 10,000 power players shouldn't be in a match with 4,000 power. Obscenely monetize, for exampl, $94 usd for a gun is outrageous. Acoins are expensive and needed for upgrades and mechs. One way or another,you have to pay ridiculous prices to unlock and upgrade. P2W FOR SURE. I'd rate lower, but i can't. It seems like it's gotten worse since i played a year ago.

Edit:4/4/2023, So I got to the point where I can match with other players and the weapon balance is a complete mess. I can keep any heavy weapon user completely CC for however long I wish. Tanks get obliterated by the "sniper rifles" dealing more damage then me and my shield combined. It's a absolute hell hole of "balance". I wouldn't recommend this game, as it pressures you hard into spending money.

The gameplay is fun, but the paywall slaps you in the face every chance it gets. Several pop ups of "reduced prices" are rifled at you after matches for things that should just be basic functional gameplay items.. There's a lot of potential but it's hidden behind all the give us your money windows, and honestly it's insulting to the game itself.

I heavily dislike the P2W features on this game. You want to get the Ember gun 6? You sadly cannot unless you wish to spend money onto the game. I'm just getting annoyed facing mechs that are higher tiers than me, along the the many weapons tiers with them. While I'm stuck with the long arms, the newly aquired fragment shots using the credits, and the couple of lock weapons and other mechs within tier 3 are lock behind the A credit. As MUCH as I'd like to give it a one star, gets two.

I enjoy this game [reminds me of HALO..] and I also enjoy that the items in the store are very reasonably priced (low cost for items and packages, starting from only just over one dollar CAD) and that you don't need to buy a thing, because if all you do is play, you get some pretty decent rewards just from gameplay alone. Ads are also available and you are rewarded well for them..I just keep my phone on silent and hit the play button for the ads, while I am watching YouTube, it isn't an issue.

Played the game for almost a month now, even put like 20 bucks into it because I was enjoying myself. It comes to a point where it cost consistent money because you can't rank up your mech without the "premium currency." You get some in the game, but it is a very slow rate and not enough for later levels. It also get to where you are getting one-shot by whales. I liked this game, it has a good start to get you hooked, and then it quickly gets to be unplayable.

The game was already pretty hard to progress without spending real money on it, but the implementation of the Gear Hub made it basically a PTW game. You're forced to buy and upgrade mechs/weapons that don't fit your play style (using in game currency that is already very hard to gain) to be able to unlock a new tier of mechs and weapons that need a lot of resources in of itself. And ofc you're still able to pay for the guns/mechs without having to unlock their respective tier :D Wth Plarium

First day I played was super fun, filled with forward progression. Game looked great, sounded great and felt great. The next day when I went back to the game it was the exact polar opposite. I did nothing but get slaughtered match after match after match and gained little to no ground. I have no patience for games where constant death and a painfully slow progression is the main theme. Needless to say I deleted the game and won't likely be going back.

Been playing this for last 1 year. Previously it was good. There was a balance between paid (Buy with dollar) and free (in game) weapons and mech. But now it's all about paid stuff. You have to spent a good amount of dollar to buy all new & powerful weapons and mechs. our old weapons are of no match! Nowadays it's just an uneven competition.

The game is great, wide variety of customisation and a large range of vehicles and weapons but the ads are on another level. They're not the normal ads, they're built in to the games showing me discounted stuff. I logged on and was greeted by 12 ads trying to get me to but discounted stuff. It's a good game but this is unreal. Progression is also quite slow and tedious. And one more thing, I suggest you add an actual mech at the end of the battle pass instead of a skin but make the pass longer.

I'm done with this company. I've been a player for a long time. The game has become pay to win. They keep adding more weapons and mechs which are more and more expensive and OP. Mechs and weapons are unbalanced and they won't fix them. The events pay less and less as rewards. Match making is absolutely terrible. You'll face a team of maxed out players and get one shot killed over and over. I'm glad I haven't spent much real money on this game because I recently uninstalled. I'll check back later

It was good, until it always placed me in premium matches. After a certain point, only playing free becomes a grind and you'll need 1,000s of A-coins to upgrade 1 item. The problem is, once you get to that point, the game matches you with all pay to win brats and there's no way to win. Imagine getting thrown into a matches where the average mech health is 40,000 and a player comes in with 150,000 hp and and can deal 40,000 damage with one bullet. That's this game. Pay to get a juggernaut.

Soooooo many ads!!! Jesus. I mean there is pay to play and then there are games like this. If they offered a one time fee, I would have paid it because the game itself is fun, but they make you basically purchase everything. The monthly pass is outrageous. Most other games like this are way cheaper. And they make you go through about 10-15 offers every single time the game refreshes. I mean, come on guys, you are making it unplayable. Developer response was generic. There is WAY more pop ups.

It's super fun to play. Easy to learn, but the controls take a little while to get fully accustomed to mobile a platform. My biggest con *BY FAR* is the awfulness of the match making when you get into the higher levels of the game. It almost seems like your team is filled with nothing but dumb AI bots that just do nothing but die quickly. Or, the opposing team is just too easy to defeat, like they are nothing but AI bots set to easy. Would be easily a 5 star game if this was fixed.

Was enjoying the game, every once in awhile would get overwhelmed by a pay wall, but not often. The developer told me they're free stuff keeps you on their level, which is an obvious lie, since the people who pay get the free stuff as well. So basically, the game is held back by a dishonest team who run the game. I'd be absolutely fine getting beat by a big spender here and there, but when the people making the game can't use simple logic, ruins it.

This could be a really fun game, except the match system is a joke. They put 2 decent players in a group with 3 terrible ones every match. Maybe it's to make people want to spend money? 🤷‍♂️ If something doesn't change in the next few days, I'm going to delete the app. New: please just develop an AI system. There are a lot of unhappy players.

Great game, been playing for nearly a year and it's still enjoyable. However, recently, with the introduction of pilots, it seems like the game is heading in a "pay to play" direction. The loading time for matches are really long. In the beginning, mechs are obtainable, but as you go, they become extremely difficult to get. The progress path is really long and getting XP for it becomes tedious. It'd also be nice if the battle pass objectives differed, all of them are basically the same.

The gameplay is fun, but the amount of real money purchase pop-ups is absolutely out of control. Every time I come back to the game I have to close NINE prompts trying to get me to buy something. I've spent money already but it's clearly not enough for Plarium. Seriously- put this stuff in the market or all in one dialog. Seven prompts in a row is so obnoxious it makes me want to just delete the game. How many times do I need to say I don't want to buy this pilot, weapon upgrade, etc? Predatory

It's fun at start, till you realized that the game is a heck of a p2w game, almost pay to play. You are always paired with powerful opponents when your just grinding for your first missile rack. Heck, you might meet opponents with disc launcher where you can't get it for free. items on shops are expensive as hell. it's skill based, but you might meet a player with the same skills as yours but with overpowered early matches mechs and weapons. 5 star game reduced to 1. I've been playing since launch, and at times I've spent a few dollars here and there. The game always had a pseudo cash grab element, but you could still be competitive without spending very much money. The latest update with mods makes even the AI controlled NPCS virtually unkillable. Its already been 6+ months since I spent anything, but I've got to say, this last update destroys even the casual nature of the game. I doubt I'll continue playing.

Unfortunately, it's pay to win. The game is a grind. Although you do get a ton of rewards, you actually have a daily limit. This limit means you can't grind for 24hours to get what you want. Forcing most to open cheap packs to progress. Unfortunately the games daily limit mechanic is horrible for free to play players. Which means after a month or two, we pay or leave. And that's why the game is FILLED with bots. No one wants to play this game. Greed kills games. That's why this gem will die.

Awesome experience until the nearly insta kill, auto aim, hunting missiles appear... The game is pretty good, however there are two main problems: 1) the prices for premium items are insane. While writing this there was a weapon in the shop going for £65, this is insane. This makes me understand pricing a bit more but still.. 65 for a fake gun? 2) guided weapons, including the one for £65, should probably be nerfed, they do alot of damage and do the hard work for you. Apart from that there are no major issues, nice game devs :)

Great game, gameplay is fun and has lots and lots of potential to climb, but unless you want to put alot of money in don't expect to get very far. Also for a game with so many micro-transactions the amount of adds is ridiculous when starting the game up, most of the time I need to close 8 adds one after another which there can be no justification for. 3 stars.

Love this game, it has easy gameplay, joining a game is quick and rarely lags. There's a multitude of game modes, such as 5v5 point control, as well as 5v5 and 2v2 death matches. Spending money does help, but it's not necessary. There's always plenty of ways to earn in-game currency for free. It does get a little repetitive, but if your looking for a new game to play and enjoy pvp and robots, then you'll enjoy this game!

This is one of the rare games that I put my money into. I do have to say. This game learn from the mistakes of War Robots and perfected the gameplay loop: "you play, you win, you play, you lose, you try again, you get stronger". Although the PAY TO WIN element is still very much prevalent. If you're smart about your hangar placement and what items you purchase. You can essentially just completely remove them from your matchmaking. Update: Big problem with smurfers. You might want to check that.

I really fricking love this game with all my passion. The mechs are cool with all their different abilities, the weapons are cool, the maps are amazing, and the gameplay is intense. But this game suffers the same problems that so many other games face, the gap between players that spend money and players that are free to play. With the addition of pilots, the gap between them got even larger. I think pilots were a cool concept and adds depth to the game, but they are too expensive and OP

Really dig this game - one of the few true games where you don't HAVE to spend money to advance. It doesn't hurt if you do, but its not necessary, and I've hardly come across any opponents who seem to have thrown cash at the game. Love the game play and various stages and maps, hardly a day goes by where I don't fire this game up and blast away. HIGHLY recommend. And no, not an employee or compensated, I just really like this game.

You have two options. Pay to win, or watch ads for a few months to get acoins. Also, these greedy people aren't satisfied with you just watching ads, when you click to close an ad, it doesn't close, it takes you to the ad (because you've clicked on it), the second time you click to close the ad, it closes. Greedy people don't care that they're cheating advertisers, and players who don't spend a thousand dollars. Edit:Why do you even bother replying to reviews, considering you won't do anything!

The game is fun but clearly pay to win. Yes you can just play it out right but ultimately you'll encounter paid players. 2ndly the controls are wonky especially the aiming...they have an auto targeting system that can tend to cycle between enemy targets if they are bunched together. 3rdly WIFI game only so you can't use cell data... other than that it's a fun game to pass the time.

This game has gotten ridiculous and a waste of time. It has been updated and turned into a money farm, and it keeps freezing up, making me restart the game. Then it won't load again unless I take a break from it. You guys have dropped the ball and taken a good game with lots of potential and ruined it. It has become more frustrating than enjoyable. In vary disappointed.

Great game early on. Nice smooth upgrading system and great controls. But you hit a point where the only way to keep being competitive is to pay, or grind for weeks on end for one upgrade. Then there's the pop-ups, so many pop-ups. Not pop-ups for events but just to try and get you to spend money. There are better, more balanced mech games out there.

I had a lot of fun playing this game when I was younger. When I tried playing this game again, I feel like the matchmaking is unfair, like how did I get 1 shot by enemy, also getting resources in this game is harder than I thought, I don't get any progress after returning with my old account. Is there a way to reset or delete my account data on this game so I can play from begining?

I've been playing for a while now the app game play experience has been getting worse. 1. When logging the game spams you with ad's every time you login. they still have not fixed it. 2. Ever new weapon and mech are put behind a pay wall this is very unfair. 3. The ad rewards system fails most of the time. 4. Finally as a consistent player they almost makes sure all the important items and even progression are behind a pay wall. Natural progression is very tedious.

Awesome game except for in-app purchases. My son gets upset bc he wants to get a cool new mech, but it's almost impossible after a certain point without spending money. It's confusing as far as what is being earned for what action and what it counts towards. It's hard for newer players to figure out the next course of action to achieve their goal. Also, the referral requirements (as a qualifier) are a bit much. Very good game, though.

Mech Arena is, contrary to a lot of other games, 100% playable without the in-app purchases. I can progress at a decent pace and take part in all of the available content without paying a single cent. The only thing I would see needing improvement is the cost for when one does decide to make an in app purchase: everything is incredibly expensive, please tone down the prices a little bit.

Seems that my first review was removed. They did reply to it though. It's a fun game to play. But IT'S. PAY. TO. WIN. That is a fact. Whenever I try to play, all my enemies already have javelins and rocket mortars. Matchmaking needs to be balanced. It hasn't even been a week since I started, yet I kept running into "game whales". I won't change my review and will continue to rate it this way if no update is done.

Great game but constantly changing. I bought (about 40 euros) several items over the last 6 months (EM Rifle 16, 12 & 10 & a mech Redeemer) together with time and in game resources upgrading them for a recent update making them effectively useless. Not happy as I spent money. I raised a support ticket and as I used them more than once they will not refund or compensate. Therefore, if you want a game that sells you something and then changes it several months later this is one for you!!

avoid this game! no balance in this game. credits for upgrading are hard to obtain, leaving low tier mechs and guns obsolite. high tier mechs and guns are impossible to get unless you want to spend real money. even if you get tiles for weapons and mechs you cant use them till you physically buy the item unlike other games were you can use the tiles to obtain the item over time. this is disappointing for a game of this type. its only a money grab in the worst way!

Fun game, but the popup in-game app purchases can be annoying. First launch of the game, and you have to get by the 10 ads. Then there the google play credits not working when one has credits to spend. Already try the faq, no luck there. Works just find in other apps, just not in mech arena. The popup are ads for "pay to win" which kills the fun of the game.

This game SHOULD be fun. Unfortunately, there are two major problems caused by developer greed. First, it's impossible to even load the game without being bombarded by micro transaction ads. On average, you will have to close TEN of them every single time you open the game. One at a time. Second, the developers have some sort of unholy fetish for stun lock effects. Every other mech in the game has one has one...and all of them are the paid mechs. Past low levels, you WILL need to pay to compete.

Game play is fun. If it wasn't for the forced 20 minute tutorial, I'd probably keep this. But I don't want to be forced to start a match with every other option locked just because the tutorial says so. I wanna put an rpg on my first mech. I wanted to do a lot, but can't, because the game treats you like a baby and button locks everything except one option. "FOLLOW THE TUTORIAL". No thanks.

This is one of the most pay to win games I've ever installed. I counted 10 pop-ups every time you log in, asking for anywhere between $1 to $100. After every match, drops you back to the main menu, asks for more money. Constantly bombarding you with transactions to succeed. The only balance in this game is your checkbook. The game looks like it was made by a couple dudes in their basement with graphics from the PS1 era. The gameplay is a series of contrived deathmatch or capture point modes.

Its an amazing game, yes, but there does need to be fixes and updates, as in a better report system, I shouldn't have to report a fake account by reporting them for cheating, as in there's an account out there named 'System' telling people to go to a link to get free A-coins. My other issue is the prices, they're so high, and you barley get any points to buy weapons, but, overall, it's a fun game.

PAY TO WIN If you don't have lots of money to spend (thousands of dollars), then prepare to get annihilated by the spenders. The spenders have way more upgraded weapons and several Mechs and weapons that aren't available to the low spenders. The game is grossly imbalanced in favor of the paying players. The developers are extremely greedy. I've not seen another game so far that trys to get you to spend so much. $50 gets you ridiculously little. Edit: Typical blow-off response by the devs.

Fun game till you hit a point after a bit of playing where you can't do well in battles unless you spend alot of money to upgrade your mechs, weapons and pilots. If you don't do so you will be slaughtered over and over and its just a garbage game at that point and feels like a huge waste of time. Don't get hooked on this cas it's just trying to drain your bank.

Steep exp tier. New to the game. A lot of fun so far. Will update more. Ads are a bit annoying every login though. 7-9 of them you have to hit x on every single time I go to the hangar. And no it's not just letting us "know about new specials". It's an onslaught geared for p2W and there is a very massive difference when all those p2w players can just one shot you. Those ads are about 50+ an hour. That's one or more per min of non game time.

Fun, too many pop ups. I really enjoy this game for the quick matches, makes a great time filler for waiting on a meeting or for a ride. What bothers me is when I first open the app, I get 7 pop ups for in game purchases. Between each match, I get an additional 2 or 3 more pop ups. I purchased the gold pass because there is value in this game. That said, if the pop ups don't decrease I will be deleting the app at the end of the current season.

I had posted a 5 star review, and this game originally was just that. But, after a couple of updates, their money hungry side has taken over, and to stay competitive will require hundreds, if not thousands of dollars. The game has failed, don't waste your time. Daily and weekly challenges mean nothing, and you have zero chance to use them to keep up. The current DL12 challenge can't be completed if you've already purpled the weapon, which means the 300 Acoins is unattainable. Fail again.

It was much more fun before Christmas of 2021. That's when they started making the focus on pay to win. Before that. You could pay for things but if you couldn't afford the extras. You could at least play for longer and grind hard for the things other people could buy. Now they hardly give anything to free to play players. They have made almost every new weapon and every newly introduced mechs, only for paying players. The way they balance the game is heavily weighted for paying players.

Literally 13 popups every time I launch the game... advertising to buy in app purchases. Game is ok, but the ads often don't give rewards, and referral system doesn't work as well as other games. Support refuse to help with literally any issue, or even look into it. They just say it's working on their side. As for their reply, there is no ticket ID. It's an in game chat with no id. So not sure what they are playing at pretending to help.

1. Pay to win. 2. Pretty much every match is against bots, which will stop shooting each other and focus fire against you while your bot teammates just spin around in circles and do nothing. 3. The controls are not responsive at all. If you're aiming at an enemy, it will randomly lock on to a different enemy that's not even in the line of sight. This is particularly annoying when you're sniping or using the rocket launchers. I'm finding another game.

Fun game, but definitely has some bugs, and once you get a few ranks in on any mech, it will either take you months of consistent play, or $20 minimum to rank up. I can only imagine this gets more expe size, and to get a top rank mech I'm guessing it will cost you hundreds. Straight pay to win. Lower skill tiers are fun, but if you aren't willing to throw down a mortgage payment later in the game, you'll never compete.

overall fun game. but seems like everyone is frustrated with the gameplay where over leveled players with purchased and legendary weapons get matched against your team. the developers will thank and apologize for the experience but won't do anything about it since there are players that do in-app purchases. would recommend this game only if you wanna kill time for a few months.

Mechanically, this is not a bad game. However, a new player, the majority of people have better gear than I do, I lose a lot. It'd be nice to be able to flag areas to allow for some coordination. There's also the possibility of spawn killing, which can be frustrating to deal with. The biggest annoyance is the shop ads. Please, please, consider sticking them in some sort of panel that can be scrolled and dismissed all at once. After dismissing 13 pop-ups, I just want to quit the game.

I have been playing this game for approximately 3 years. The match making use to be very good.... Now match making sucks! I just played 8 matches in a row, switched different modes and lost every one. New game mods are pointless because they cater to bought weapons. There are 1 million things in the game that you can pay for with real money. Unless you put $50 into the game continually, you will not win. This game is a pay to win! ONLY download and play if you want to pay! Otherwise stay away!!

I could swear this game was made by EA, it's a really solid game that was ruined because of pay to win. There is a good amount of variety in mechs and weapons, letting you really customize what YOU feel is best, however, as mentioned, It's VERY pay-to-win! You get credits very very slowly, and you see people who obviously bought a $60 pack that gave them a crazy op mech/weapon combo that your puny little "earned weapons" can't even kill. 0/10 because the potential was almost as high as the greed

The game is mildly fun. I am frustrated because it was an offer on an offer wall to get gems for another game. I had to earn 10000 exp in 1 week. It seemed possible at first but I started to realize after about 4-5 days of playing a lot that i work not make it unless i spent over 40$. That is despite taking every opportunity to gain exp and playing a lot. Very frustrating!!

It's a lot of fun and very well made but the whole thing is plagued with popup ads wanting you to buy something. Like 5-10 ads popup you have to close before you can do anything. And it's almost each time you go to the home screen. Beyond that progression is slow because "earning" new mechs or weapons only earns you the ability to purchase them, sometimes for exorbitant prices. The game could be great but I won't play it for more than a week because it's just a shameless money grab.

The game is really good but I have some issues, the game hits you with 3,000 adds as soon as you start, also if you're fighting someone with higher level mechs, weapons, pilots and implants you will lose guaranteed. Then the money you need to get new mechs, weapons, pilots and level up said things are hard to build up ( A-coins more so than credits ). Then there's the pay to win crates that give you the hard to earn money and upgrade card's which make it extremely unfair for the new players!

Great game! ... But Broken. After just 5 battles, I can not play a 6th after dozens of attempts. Watched 30 ads (must watch 2 minimum), received 1 reward. I'm glad I waited more than 30 minutes before deciding to spend money in this game. No customer support can be found, and my recommendation is not to waste time downloading this game. Shame it could have been a lot of fun and unlike other people I spend money on good games.

It's a good game to play but it's become "War Robots" when it comes to pay to play! Not including the retarded prices these developers are asking for things. Plus they have bots that are to smart and crafty to be non-real players behind them. I'll play against some other player that destroyed the battlefield and go to see who they are and have no ID or nowhere to be found.

The game itself has a nice concept and is actually enjoyable in my opinion, BUT the issues of the game are being handled very poorly by the company itself sadly. Instead of working on the issues at hand within the game, they release new weapons and mechs. What's worse is the lack of communication between the players and the devs. Lastly the gameplay in the recent month forces you to whale a bit due to difficulty of keeping up with both bots and players.

It's a great game, visuals and graphics are good. But as you progress unlike before, you get mechs from progressing. Now I literally need to buy mechs and weapons with real money. There's only 5 mechs that can be bought with credit, most of them are Pay-to-Use. Also the tournaments isn't any better. When I get 5 wins, the pairing system becomes unfair. You start a match and you're enemies are using 5⭐ Legendary mech and arsenals. Overall, I see it as a solid P2W. I just hope it can be fixed.

The Game was better before last update... Lots of lag and freezing recently... and you can only rank up so far... the game doesn't provide proper credits or even ways to earn large amount of credits at a time... but they expect you to level up... So in other words you can only get so far without spending real cash to stay competitive or even level up past 3 star or get certain weapons and upgrades...or pilots and mech robots.... I didn't mind spending alittle cash on it before... not now!

Fun to play, like I saw on some of the other reviews, there's too many pop ups for "sales". it's spam, nothing more! why have a store when you're going to forcibly show every single sale you have going on when I open the game? Plus this game is turning more P2P driven than just being a fun game, sell prestige skins, have the ability to buy rss, but weapons and mechs should be earned, by grinding and playing the game. Which then would encourage everyone to play more. Don't become War Robots.

Yeah, it's a good game. But can you add more popups on each game start? Like 57 more popups pushing me to buy things? I would minimize the game sometimes and when I get back, I need to close all these popups once again in order to play. Every time. At least show them once per day. I get it that you need to pay your bills, but you are just too much aggressive with the approach of shoving the ads in my face. Decrease the number of popups, and I will increase the rating.

My second opinion after approx three months of gameplay: forget this one. First everything is pay to play, and I don't even want to say how much dinero I have dropped on this game. But knowing they make a lot of cash, still Pla doesn't have enough computing power to keep games up and running at any given time of day. I can't tell you how many times I get into a game only to freeze up and/or get kicked off platform due to a hangup. No use even trying this one if Pla can't get it fixed. DONT

This game is great! The graphics are awesome, the people are nice (most of the time). The game is all around amazing, and I would not hesitate to give you guys 5 stars if this one problem was fixed soon. Everytime I exit the game for something and try to get back in I can never make it past the login screen. A little message box pops up completely blank and when I click on it, it kicks me out over and over. So everytime I have to delete the game and then redownload it. This is a recent issue. TY

After several years and spending probably over $300 on in-app purchases, the game is nowhere near as enjoyable anymore. The entire reason I bought into Mech Arena was because it took skill and technique to become one of the best. But now they have unbeatable setups that call for zero skill where you just run around invincible shooting your weapon. I've deleted the game now.. completely not worth playing.

Game is fun but there are so many problems in it that it often becomes difficult to find a reason to continue playing it. Feels like with every update the number of bugs that appear double the number that they fix. Bots overrun most matches in numbers and the few players that do appear are usually far better equipped than me. The only way to get top tier mechs is by grinding ungodly amounts of hours into the game. Even warcraft grinding seems meek in comparison. I'd go on but 500c is the limit..

This is a fun game, you can get items and mechs without spending money....but be ready to grind for weeks to do it! Already people are spending 100's of $ and they smash all around. Trying to get the blue prints to upgrade what you do have is extremely slow unless you spend lots of money. I get the developers need to make money. you could spend 1,000$ and have lots of fun. I have spent 75$ and that's enough! Fun game to pass some time, but quickly turning into another pay to win.

I am tired of constantly losing. The bots are dumber than a rock. The costs for upgrading and buying anything with credits is absurd. The new stuff that players need to use actual money to get are not in the list. An example is how Archangel isn't in the list of pilots or how the longarm 12 isn't in the list of weapons. Let's not forget that I get harmed by every sniper weapon that is aiming at me, but misses the shot. Weekly objectives don't act as weekly objectives.

Fun game! Good graphics and mechanics. Great variety of mechs, weapons, and maps. As others have said, it is hard to progress without dishing out a couple bucks, but it is possible, as many events are held where you can earn mechs, weapons, and game money. I would give 5 stars, but I think the battle matching system should be based off your squads power or a battle rank, not your exp. With the current match system it's difficult to get higher than a 50% win rate.

The best way to describe the "new player experience" is that you are thrown into a game with fun 3rd person shooter mechanics, but it's made to overly appeal to the Overwatch-Mobile-Game(TM) fandom. Quests that are complete after every game, players who can't competently hold a phone (or bots), and a hero system that doesn't need to exist. Not to mention, the mechs, the main part of the game, are locked behind PREMIUM CURRENCY. That means you have to play consistently or pay for them. Meh...

Absolutely impossible to progress without any decent weapons and upgrades. This shows that the developers have given up completely. I cannot stand playing this game anymore. I am dead serious. Too much Pay 2 Win, unfair matches, impossible to upgrade due to high prices etc. My best tip is: Don't play this game. Literally. If one of you dev team sees this message, please... Make the game better for everyone. But not for Greedy Goblins.

I love this game. I really do. The combat system, the various mechs and the design is fantastic. The one problem is the in game currency. You just never have enough credits, A coins and pilot marks.you have to farm hard for credits and by the time you do get enough for one upgrade, you have acquired enough blueprints to do 10 other upgrades and the credits just aren't enough. And don't get me started on the A coins. They basically force you to spend money yet the prices are ridiculous.

Excessive number of pop ups, there are a dozen or so upon booting up the game and they occasionally reappear when going to the hanger after a match. Otherwise the gameplay is fun. Also the game heavily favors players that pay into it, and requires you to buy something to progress a "free" in game event, otherwise you can't get the main awarf since you come up short of the event tokens needed

Generally a Fun game, definitely influenced by war robots. I had to lower my rating due to their extremely terrible customer service. I'm literally being ignored by them on an problem that I encountered when using a youtubers link. On top of that, the developers are extremely greedy. They keep "deals" popping on your screen constantly. Most 10$+. I'm now being offered a 70$ deal just for a mid grade weapon at its based level. That ridiculously over priced. You guys need to stop being greedy.

Took me a minute to figure out the Bluestacks 5 trick to get the xbox controller for PC to work even though it was connected you still have to select it on the screen just before battle (only once). Pretty cool though! If you play WarRobots (remastered) you'll enjoy this one too. Don't level too fast by getting upgrades, enjoy the lower levels ;)

%1000 Pay to win. you can try as hard as you want but a new player can buy better gear and smoke you before you can see them. UPDATE: The company responded saying "we have current pathways to advance" it would take me months to advance one of my bots. While a new player spends $100 and gets it right away. This game is not worth it to play if you actually want to play to advance. Perfect if you want to spend a ton of money and be number 1.

The game is excellent, the mechanics and content is very nice and polished. It's a lot of fun except when someone who pays 50 dollars for a new bot and weapons wipes out your entire team and ruins the whole experience. A shame such a cool and polished game is yet another pay to win game. You are warned. Update: just uninstalled the game, unplayable unless you're willing to spend a lot of money. A shame, really.

A fun game to begin with but you soon hit a paywall where to get anything good you have to shell out some money. Too many feeders or bots. I have no issue supporting a game here and there but it's almost necessary to not get destroyed in higher tiers. Some weapons cost $35! That's insane. I could buy a full game for that. When I log in I just got 13! Pop-ups to get me to spend money. Avoid this predatory game. This is the kinda game kids steal dad's credit card.

I remember my last review was in 2023, and here I am again. The devs kept replying that the in-game purchases are optional. They are optional IF the game was balanced. Earnings per match are so low you can't even progress fast and you might even be forced to buy stuff in order to somewhat match those spending addicts. Matchmaking is horrible too. The game has too many pop ups of in-game purchases and events that aren't even considered beneficial to grind. How far you've fallen from glory days.

The game is very interesting. The gameplay is nice and the presentation is appealing. But please reduce the amount of in-game purchase 'reminders' when the game is opened, and allow us to also see who teamed up on the opponent's team. Also allow us to see the damage we did in deathmatches. Plus make is possible for us to search for players using their name also instead of only player I'd.

Gave this 5 stars originally. Update: This game sucks unless you're a whale. There are better weapons that you can only get by paying. Literally unique one-of-a-kind stuff like AoE guided discs, insanely OP mechs with game breaking abilities that cost anywhere between $60-100; Plarium is scummy and greedy as hell when it comes to microtransactions. Came back to see what changed; no surprise, the game got even more microtransaction-heavy than ever. Now more ads. Not worth playing at all.

Heyyy, this game can be one of the best but the problem is it's pay to win and if you're free to play you can't progress at all. Too little rewards for insane prices and I'm not the first one to say it. Not enough A-coins nor credits or the pilots's currencies. It's just impossible to get better if you don't pay. This game is fun and I used to play it a lot. I just came back and it's still impossible to progress. Listen to the community like the solo leveling arise devs. This game is can be good

Edit from 5 star to 2 star. I used to love this game because it was a pretty fun mecha shooter that didnt feel p2w like almost every game out here. That is... at least it used to, back when I started playing after watching a The Dooo ad. The devs had put a lot of work and love into a game and it was great! Then they added the Guardian and the Zephyr and I leveled up and realized it was just a facade. Like so many other games, the illusion of it being good just falls apart once you get hooked.

This game is actually a lot of fun, giant robots fighting each other. There's a diverse assortment of Mecha and weapons, but beware it is THOROUGHLY pay to win. Unless you pay real money you'll be constantly outclassed by players with better weapons with more upgrades. Most mechs and weapons can be purchased with enough grinding (we're talking months for some stuff), though not all. In addition Mech Arena has a serious bot problem, and even a spambot on the main channel.

Each time I open the game, it freezes during gameplay. Unsure why. I try exiting out and returning, didn't work. I restarted my phone several times, didn't work. I checked to see if something was up with my data/wifi-connection. Both were working. This isn't an issue with my phone, so it's likely the app I installed has a glitch in it. I would genuinely appreciate some help here.

This game is amazing I never get bored. No ads. Would reccomend. But it is one of those pay to win games also I just had to delete half my apps to update the game:(. Also the pop ups trying to make you buy stuff is so annoying. Also some of the weapons are too overpowered and kill you instantly. Therefore, my 5 star review has gone down to a 4 star review.

Very perditory marketing tactics, making you spend way more money than you think because of how much they make you change in game currency to hide the value of items. Also, in the game, there are constant fake sales that are just the real price of items, but make it seem like you are constantly about to miss out and fall behind. Wouldn't let kids play this if they have the ability to make online purchases on the device this is installed on. My brother Lost about $500 on it from that in one day

POS game. You lose to OP bots that are fully upgraded and don't miss. Don't spend money on this game you'll always be outgunned by the bots! Also, good luck leveling up without spending a ridiculous amount. I understand you want to make money, but once upon a time a game was sold for a certain price and you get access to the entire game. Now you can spend hundreds and still be at a disadvantage.

Needs work. It's nearly impossible to stay competitive without spending money. A lot of money. While new weapons and mechs come available quickly, unlocking them so that they are usable requires in-game currency which is scarce at best. The latest weapon I unlocked costs over 800k of the basic currency. Since you get the currency mainly from rewards and those rewards are based on performance, you can see the difficulty in staying relevant during a battle while you try grind for credits.

This game is a pay to win. I been playing this game over a year plus now . Never used real cash been playing and upgrading with the money I win within the game. As of lately how can you pair a squad of 2300 with a squad of 4000 plus I just cannot under stand that!!!!!!! Madness. Players squad power should be matching. Use a better algorithm to match the battles. Other than that the game runs great graphic is amazing. Imagine I even got my wife to play someone who don't even play games.

I wouldn't recommend. Lots of pop-ups, mechs are slow, matchmaking is unbalanced, the target moves onto other opponents before finishing off the one you're shooting at. You're not in control of it. You'll do most of the kills in your team and still lose for months until eventually you give in and start adding real money. But it never ends. Keeps asking for more. By far the greediest game I played so far.

BEST GAME OF MECHS PERIOD. Listen we all know how crazy some transactions can be, but in this game you are getting exactly what you pay for, plus a lot of the things I bought already gave me back their value in currency! If you are a new player, is gonna feel very slow. And yes, the pop ups may be annoying, however remember that you are not watching ads that kill your cache. Finally, I just would like to have a little extra for every purchase. Maybe getting rid of the pops? Or getting some bps

Fun mech game, a lot of variety and builds to mess with. But the in-game paid promotions get outrageous, starts off for a few dollars an item. The more you buy the more expensive the items get. Next level $8 to $15 dollars. Next level $25 to $50(+) some items are listed for $100. I have three accounts and all three have different prices for the same things, just different star rating. At my level $50 for a new mech is unrealistic.

It's just a series of paying players using emp abilities to immobilize you and use their overpowered weapons to bully you. I've only been playing a few months, and I have bought items in the game, and all of my purchases were misleading and left me with unusable weapons and mechs for the events. The cost to level/rank up is absurd. New overpowered content ruins the game for new payers, who are seen and treated as fodder for those who pay. $89 for a single in game item. Need money to play.

The whole garage and strategy side is broken. Every corner of the screen is filled with some mission accomplishment. Good luck getting blueprints to upgrade for anything you purchase on your own. Basically forced to play constantly, open achievements like a robot, and only upgrade whatever weapons and mechs given to you by the game. Could be a fun game if we were allowed to build what we wanted, and you got rid of %90 of rewards and %70 of pop-up ad deals.

This app is collecting and sharing your videos and photos from your device ! The game is about 90 % bot robots. , Which means it doesn't matter how good or bad you play, it only matters how strong or weak the programmed bots enemies are. Whit this technic, the company has full controll over your game process. If you have a gambling problem, don't play this game, as the main base is lucky drawing gambling. The in-game prices are around 10-20 euros average. Most good content is not available free

How do I get my account back? I played this game for about four years..spent some money, not a lot, but not enough to win. Most cheating game I ever played against a computer or people who spent thousands a week to win. It wasn't that way at first. It's impossible to keep up. Then, my phone updated and uninstalled the game on its own, so I lost my progress, all my robots, weapons, upgrades, everything... can't find an option to get my account back. complete waste of time for a pay to win game.

The game overall isn't bad, in concept or actual gameplay. My only true complaint, that honestly makes me want to walk away, is the match making makes absolutely no sense. In that, there isn't any. It will match you with people with mechs they paid 50 dollars for just so you can get stomped over and over. At this point most maps don't even have a way to hide from the guided weaponry. At a certain point it makes the game unplayable or at least unenjoyable.

Update #1: I cycled power, and insured the latest software and firmware versions were installed on all devices. I switched the graphics quality to the lowest settings, "Good", and it seemed to fix the stutter and lag elements. Update #2: Control point battles seem to play fine, but 5v5 and Free-for-all are still lagging. First, let me say I've been playing this game for a while. This game has become so laggy as to make it unplayable.

I played for 6-8 months and progressed steadily with occasional purchases of few bucks here and there. Problem is once you played a couple months you start to hit the pay wall where you have to pay to compete as matchmaking often pairs you with those 3 to 4 tomes your power making it impossible to overcome. Amazing gameplay with variety of mechs, weapons and maps that make things strategic and fun for awhile. I uninstalled after no response in forums and progressively worse matching.

Pay to win. If you have the money then by all means come wipe out the loyal players that have been here from day one and didn't want to spend thousands of dollars for a free to play game. And the in game currency you "win" is not enough to keep up. 100,000 to up grade a mech and you get at most 1800 from each crate. Edit/update: the game has gotten even more expensive from when I posted this rating. And as you can see from their reply they don't really care.

I love this game and I'm deleting it. Great game, fun and quick, lots of action. Second, DO NOT DOWNLOAD unless you're willing to spend SIGNIFICANT cash on this game. You'll lose not to a good player but to someone with $100+ invested into their mech. Not exagerating. I've put $15-20 into the game and barely made a dent. There are discount offers but they also detract from the game because you get 10+ offers to go through everytime you start the game. Great game ruined by greed.

Pay to Win once you advance, otherwise it was fun. Literally must buy advanced weapons with real cash, NO OTHER WAY to get them. Sure there are contests, but only then a 1% chance. Adv. weapons and mechs those your opponents take you out in one shot while regular weapons take many hits. I still win, but every level up of regular weapons and I lose more. Find another game, play only a short time, or be ready to pay - a lot. Edit: their response is purchases are optional, it's lies.

Very active and even exciting and interactive game play. However I am personally very adept at being patient, spending nothing, but getting very advanced weaponry as I've learned to play such games. 1st I began noticing being placed in more difficult areas upon the start of games. Despite this I adjusted. Then I started noticing that many of my shots were off target. When I never had this problem after 9 months of game play. Lastly my number keypad was hacked by the site. This is when I stopped.

Don't play this game! Was going to leave detailed review, But only have 500 characters. Game is a money grab. *Every time you log on hit with 5 "offers" *If you buy a offer next time the cost goes up and the deals get less better. *Matchmaking is a joke. You will face people and bots with max gear when you won't even be close to max *You can't get refunds on items like you can with supercell games. *If you play stay f2p so when it gets dumb you can uninstall. There's more, but not enough space.

Pretty nice gameplay. Annoying popups of store offers ingame. Everytime you open the game or go back to hangar after a match. There is also extremely hard to get the weapons and mechs as well as upgrading them later in the game unless you spend some real cash. Its a alright game to pass time and better than most other mobile games. I wont be playing any more though. Thanks.

It has a good game idea, and the game play is high performance on a 5 yr old phone (60+ fps). But the bad rating is because: 1. Literally half the game content is behind a pay wall for 100$ per legendary weapon. Which is just insane. 2. SO MANY FREAKING POPUPS!!, and not just a lot, but u can't spam click out of them. U need to wait 1 second in-between each popup closed. 3. Pilots wear clothes that are WAY too revealing

Sadly this started out great, but has become yet another pay to win game. Weapons and mech advantages are slowly but surely nurfed and you can't "earn" fast enough to buy anything competitive despite the numerous tournaments (even if you play 24/7). If you want a decent experience you are forced to purchase overpriced items which will again be nurfed in short order forcing you to keep on paying. Great business model, lousy gaming experience

Very fun game to play to play with a lot of opportunities to customize to your play style. Matchmaking enjoyment does seem to heavily lean on who has more pay to win team members though on each squad. Sometimes games feel balanced while others, there's a clear standout based on $$ spent on kits. Also, there seems to be 6-10 popups now anytime you log in. When you are finally in a match, it is an enjoyable game overall.

I didn't expect to actually enjoy this game, I'm more of an Adventure RPG and dating sim kind of gamer, but I'm actually surprised by how much fun I've been having! Though I do wanna bring up that there is a small glitch that when someone kills you, it can sometimes display the name of a team member or even your own name. But it's a small thing, this game has been a great experience otherwise!

This game is so addictive. I can't stop playing it. and I would recommend anyone who likes third person shooter games to try this game out. There is so much to do and get. There is so many guns and mech you can get this is one of my favorite games. But one of the problems they have is it is pay to win and when you log on to the game to have to click through 8 gun and mech promotions before you can play. You will also experience this problem when you get a new gun or mech.

So pros and cons with this game. I absolutely love game, I want to just keep playing more and more but it's highly and I mean highly pay to play and when you get to about 4k ranking score is where you get a lot and you just won't win. There are weapons that cost 40 dollars real money and pretty much destroy you that's not including their mech, pilot and implants are all maxed on every mech, support trys to say its balanced but no way when a weapon destroys you that easily, sad to see tbh

Game is great! Get all of the trash low end bots out that are unstoppable! It is still garbage that a level 1 (all level 1) and a level 2 (all level 2) player is smoking a player with a lot of strength. This is probably a ploy to get people to spend more money, just to have bots smash you as soon as the map opens! It's so bad that an emp doesn't work on them!

This used to be a fun game. I played it for like 2 years now. It was kinda pay to play to speed up progress. I've spent a bit on it and didn't mind. Then they got rediculously greedy. Last update adds "mods" that all enemy AI mechs all have right away but you need to scrimp and save for like a month to get a basic one. Which means it takes like 4-5 full attacks to kill one but until you earn some, you can be one shot in 0.467 seconds. The greed went from a 5/10 to a 9/10.

Fun to play. There are things they can do to make the experience better, I am not the only one to feel this way: stop the pop ups when entering the game. There have been times where I wanted to buy in game, but the pop up ads frustrated me so much that I decided to not even enter the store at all. Maybe put all the deals on a single splash screen to avoid closing 7-10 windows. Also, costing a-coins to remove implant parts is bad. To lose resources you may have paid for sucks.

While I do enjoy this game quite a lot as a quick and fun easy to jump in mech shooter and I don't emulate the feelings of others that it's hard to get the premium currency (it's not, just play the game) I will say I'm removing points for a few reasons, first and foremost, the amount of in game popups to buy things with real money, I don't need to know after every match, secondly, was doing some event quests and one of them was just "make an in-game purchase" which had to be $ kind of scummy imo

I played for about 2 weeks, and it was alot of fun, but the customer service is completely useless. I pointed out an obvious bug in a quest, and they told me some BS about it working as intended when it was extremely obvious that a decimal place had been missed. I would recommend you spend your time and money somewhere else, as the people running this game can't be bothered to do their job!

Excellent game at first, but becomes pay to win quickly. They offer many ways to earn credit in the game for free, but never enough to make a difference without spending real money past 3 stars on weapons and mech. They offer Mechs for $0.99 or $1.99 from time to time, but at a reduced level. To bring them usable with weapons power you would need to grind in game for weeks, or spend lots of cash. Times this by 5 mech slots and weapons and pilots you are talking hundreds of real dollars.

I get matched with so many pay-to-win players. It's unfair for free-to-play players, especially for me who just wants to enjoy a game without spending a single dollar. Either they make a different matching system for the whales, or players will keep complaining. Edit: I heard they've nerfed some weapons. But that's not what a lot of people want. We want different match-making systems for pay-to-win and different for free-to-play. ex: If there's 1 whale, 4 f2p, then the enemy should be the same.

Ugh this is a tough one. The game is really really fun, and I don't mind paying in general, but they ask SO much for so little in return, and everything is geared to rage you into buying. When you get a fake match it's so fun. The gameplay , graphics, juice, it's all there and fun. But at some point you'll have to grind for weeks for currency or pull out the wallet if you wanna have fun. A shame really. Play it for a bit, have fun, then move on.

Super addictive, fun, and competitive. I'm not the type of person to play these kinds of games, but I'm hooked. My only concern is the prices in the shop. I've bought a couple of items/mech and they are worth it but the prices can be rather over the top and it adds up. 12$ for an epic gear that can't be equipped completely because you don't have the right mech with proper energy capacity which requires you to upgrade which cost more $ or buy another mech thats pricey puts you out about $25+. 🤔

A good game currently ruined by awful decisions regarding weapons and upgrades. If you want to try it anyway just don't spend any money until they fix the issues. The worst at the moment is massively overpowered ranged weapons called rocket mortars which take no skill to use and wipe out multiple opponents at once. This turns an enjoyable team duel game into a pointless Battleships clone with graphics. Sad really. Lots of really good elements to this game otherwise.

Good overall. Wish they would stop following war robots playbook and be creative original. Most disappointing is having to pay to switch pilot add ons after I've already paId to acquire them. Let us move weapons and customize our builds freely with any pilot or option in our arsenal. Since your in business to make a profit, maybe small credits flat fee for changeouts. At last we'll play more & have more fun. Also, let us liquidate unwanted bots, weapons for nice credits to do more new builds.

Many hackers put me off playing. Developers do not make it easy to report such players, requiring u to video record and email them!?!? Agreed with many here that they should just include an option to report a player after a match and investigate from there. Many are straightforward cars where a lvl 1 mech w lvl 1 weapons can destroy opponent mech with a touch of their rays or a hit with their bullet. Their experience lvl are low and yet their total damage score is off the roof!

Not worth it. I have given you $30 for a phone game that is unplayable, or at least not worth playing. You log in, you have to click past 57 offers of $10, $20, $100. Mediocre gameplay with a competitive facade, but all that really matters to be "good" is the right gear which you can expect to pay $5-$50 dollars for... Per piece. This is for 9yos with Mommy's wallet. Still playing, but no more money. This is horrible. Plus you get basically nothing , followed by actually nothing if you play long

Whilst the graphics are fun and the combinations of mech & weapons are varied, what lets this game down is the AI. Whether programmed intentionally or not (and a cynical person would say it was deliberate) the game gives you about 30-60 minutes of having fun before it slams you with the pay-wall...and hard. The team matching is either poorly programmed or designed to get you angry enough (at getting walked over every round) that you go to their store and buy upgraded mechs and weapons.

Really cool game. No annoying ads. Yes, the game has ads for its own items, but nothing bad at all Definitely playable without having to pay. But obviously, you can tell who spends money when you see someone with an outrageously high ranked item. lol But still lots of fun. Just don't get caught up with the need to have every item. Just have fun.

I love everything about the game from it's graphics to the gear but the pop ups are crazy. Everytime you go to the hanger or load the game you get at least 10-20 pop ups of the same stuff you don't want to buy. It would be better if they only poped up when you load the game or you should be able to turn it all off. Everything else is good and it's sometimes worthwhile pressing 20 X's to play the game.

Great game! But unless you are prepared to spend a lot of money on this game I wouldn't bother! At first it's ok you are competitive but once you start moving up the ranks they put you against players with better Mechs and weapons and that's to make you buy the same Mechs and weapons! Mechs £100, weapons £50 na it's way too expensive, you can end up spending loads because the saga goes on and on! more and more money! 😕 Also I have noticed the game is full of cheats which needs sorting out quick

Very fun game...when it works. Constant lag and disconnects in the hangar are killing the experience though. Go to pickup daily tasks, have to wait 5 mins while it loads. Watch an ad for a chest, vid plays fine but lags out getting the reward when its done. I spend more time waiting on connection in the hangar than I do playing. And then things completely time out and I get kicked back to the login splash where I have to wait another 5-10 mins just to get back into the game.

I just remembered why I dislike this game.. The disc launcher. For anybody who likes to P2W in this game all you have to do is purchase the disc launcher and shoot at anything even if they're hiding behind walls, and even if you are not aiming at any mech just shoot it'll do damage. Plus the reload time is pretty fast, and it has great range too. So there y'all go folks. Thank me later. Oh! And a level 16 disc launcher is available, purchase and start shooting.

Game is great, mechanics fun, lots to do, and prices of items are perfectly normal for this type of gaming... Pop-up ads are NOT necessary to YOUR extent. I tested this 12 times. Every time I opened the app, 12 pop-ups. Same ones right after the other. Ads are not even worth the pop-up to begin with. Ads make you money. Pop-ups only make a few more cents to the dollar, but you lose more customers, and the money doesn't match anymore. Give me a different excuse than "So we don't miss out on it."

Fun games but to many pop ups. I understand the store is how the game is funded, but 10 pop ups Everytime you log in discourages players from logging in or spending. Let us spend because we appreciate the game and want to support you, not because you're being pushy. Outside of that great game with opportunity even for free players. I don't even mind the occasional pop ups in between matches. Fix the bombardment of pop ups at log in and I'll gladly change to a 5 star review.

The game is only fun long enough to make you believe it is different from all the other sleazy games out there. But once you start to grow your "hanger" the facade drops. Skill is not a determining factor in the outcome of any match. Your teammates and opponents will be a mix of players and dev-bots selected to ensure that you will either win or lose, depending on what the algorithm has chosen for your fate.

It is a very fun game, and I love it. There is a big problem though, the equipment is much to pay for. I also spend a lot of time just to find out that it was for nothing. I can't afford anything. Make the match making more equal as well. Also make the prices less for all the mechs and equipment, PLEASE. Thank you for understanding my problems.

I would rate it higher but the game has too many cheaters making you lose connection and then kills you or they have a weak weapon but kills you with one shot and the higher you upgrade the more expensive it cost so almost impossible. Also support help does nothing when uou report a cheater instead ask to send proof. How are we to do that when it happens during game play. Also you can't search for players w/o their user ID # but there's no way to click on players. And can't turn off auto aim.

It's really sad, because I love this game to death. It is the best mobile shooter I've ever played. Except every new thing costs so much money its not even funny. It costs over 8,000 A-coins for the carbines which I believe is close to the equivalent of 60 or 70 dollars. I spent over 2,000 A-coins to try to get the new shotgun 8 and I wasn't even able to get it because there was such a low chance. This game suffers from being so pay to win It's painful.

Too many popups. You're talking about how people might miss wanted deals, but with so many popping up I don't even look at the deals anymore. How about a single "Check out our deals" one and take is directly to your sales? That way no one will be as annoyed by them? I'm seeing so many reviews saying the same thing.

Now don't get me wrong: This game has some great aspects about it that I very much like about it. However, there are several issues. 1. AI team is far too strong compared to player team, which is unfair. 2. Matchmaking seems to be based on level and not really by rank, leading to some questionable matches. 3. The game is not really p2w, but is a bit too reliant on money. I love this game, and I hope this helps out! Edit: Thanks for responding, you guys are doing great and I hope I helped out.

This game was really cool when I first started playing. That quickly changed when they started adding weapons and mechs for sale to the game, and it quickly became swamped with players who paid hundreds of dollars just so they could win a tournament battle. It's okay if you want to spend money to win a game that has no monetary return. Every developer seems to be navigating towards this these days and people buy into it. If you want to win be prepared to pay big money for a participation trophy.

This game is so close to being what War Robots used to be, it can be really fun at times, even with a limited arsenal, but this doesn't quite outdo the negatives. To start, this game is crowded with in app purchases for weapons that are just unfair, the game has terrible matchmaking, and getting any new thing takes a long time to unlock and then buy with how resource starved this game keeps you. Also, the just slows to a crawl and I had to restart the app, never had an issue like that before.

I would like to give it five stars but the experience is dampened because of how many ads there are the moment you open the app And due to the fact that most the time premium currency weapons can be imbalanced. you also have to spend a lot of money to really progress in the game. I recommend this game for people willing to spend a lot of money and for people who don't really care about progressing and if they like fun action

No skill. There are a variety of weapons that have auto aim and there is no point dodging. I also hate the auto locking feature. I have died very many times because there were two enemies and the game tracks the wrong guy. The mechs are too slow and again there is no point in trying to dodge. Imo, every mech should be at least as fast a Killshot and mechs like Lancer would be extremely fast. Shields are to OP. Fix this game.

I really enjoyed this game, but lately it's taking too long to load. Even opening crates takes forever and there's no way to exit the screen that I have to relaunch the app which takes me back to the first problem. I've also been experiencing match making errors frequently. It's frustrating that I'm missing out on rewards. The game's basically unplayable for me, so I might have to move on and uninstall if this keeps up.

A fun mech arena shooter. Feels like it needs a pop up blocker for all the offers every time I go to menu though. Pay to win mostly, but if I paid $35 USD for a weapon for my mech, it better be good-- and it is--- and that makes the game very difficult for people starting out. It isn't impossible to take out those pay to win people though, which is the only reason I continue to play.

The game is pretty fine, nice graphics, fluid animation and decent gameplay mechanics, but this game needs to be unique, it's pretty much just based around who ever has a bigger and stronger gun wins the match, so instead of making a game based on just buying, why not add more mobility, let all mecha jump without cool down, be able to dash with a short cooldown, each mech should have its own set of abilities and movement mechanics Skill over gil (money)

Great game. Fast paced and extremely fun but there is a slight issue whenever I die and jump into a new mech the mech just doesn't move and in the cases where it does move it's at a snails pace. Don't know if this is a bug or maybe a game mechanic but it's annoying and it costs me matches. Please fix this. Other than that nothing else to complain about.

It's like any other mech/robot game...except it's actually good! There is so many small details that make this game good. Every mech has a unique ability, every weapon has at least some value, and there is even a feature where you can run faster for a few seconds! I really wish there were more game modes though, there is only control point, 5v5 and 2v2. There is a lot of potential!

Theres only 3 things I don't like about the game is the price is way to high then you have the battle pass the price is ok but why purchase the battle pass when none of the robots you are really trying to get pops up in the battle pass awards. The price of the great robots cost so much you wouldn't even bothered looking at the discounts for the week. Last is there's no other way to earn A- coins but to buy them with the prices why not give players a lil help with the A coins.

It requires way too many in-game purchases to be competitive. They also fill the game with bots, so it's not even really pvp. The bots eventually get way too OP because they're loaded with hundreds of dollars worth of gear. The company is clearly way too greedy and that's why it's 95% bots and 5% real people. Funny thing is they could charge way less for upgrades and their player base would grow so much that they would end up making more money in the long run.

Id give this game 5 stars but I have to agree with everyone's opinions on the matter, if you don't make any purchases this game is a slog to get through, and not even worth it, but given if you make a few purchases the game in all its amazing aspects really do shine, but unless cash is on hand id say protect yourself and your wallet, the game is far better in terms of paying to win instead of War Robots which demands money if you want to try and have fun, but yeah, painfully long time investment

This game is a perfect example of how you should never spend on games. It was fun to begin with, but then you hit a paywall and its impossible to play. The moment you show yourself, every enemy bots with ignore other bot they are fighting and melt you with their stupid auto aim. Unless you are prepared to spend big on this game, don't expect to progress much. And to top it off, devs made a recent change where they changed pricing on their packs meaning spend more for resources.

*Broken Mechanic, Fix Needed* The game is a fun enough arena shooter, with a decent progression system, and a bit of P2W to it. You can still have some good entertainment F2P as long as you're not set on winning any tournaments. There is a broken mechanic where homing missiles cannot be used at all indoors, as they fire straight up into the ceiling. It's an easy enough detail to miss, but a fix is really needed here.

Graphics and battle are great and fun, but the game eventually becomes pay-to-win the further you advance. I think that makes the matchmaking really horrible and imbalanced. The worst part about the game is the constant ads in your face. The moment you start the game, they throw 5-6 ads of their 'promos' one after another and you have to close one after another before you can finally start playing. That was what made me uninstall some time ago and now im feeling it again.

Addicting, but disappointing. Honestly, the "rewards" don't even make up for the amount of unjustifiable times you need to "upgrade" a bunch of weapons and mechs. The matching is absurd. Even if you're at the top division, the disadvantage is big for those who didn't P2W. Would've been more enjoyable if they matched players with the same abilities and levels of weapons amongst each other, rather than have the latter win by default just because they paid. Definitely not worth your time.

Too much pop up offers to spend money everytime you open the game, if you close the game multiple times a day, and referral didn't work. Didn't get nothing as my friends ranked up. Edit in response to developer comment. Your excuse to overwhelm with pop ups is my excuse to not play the game and Uninstall. Ridiculous how the idea of letting someone remove the pop up once a day and still keep it in shop like many other mobile games is not possible. And you didn't mention lack of referal reward.

After div 1, it becomes very much a p2w game. Expensive mechs and weapons outshine anything you can grind for. Tournaments are there but are hard to get anything if you're not that good and are a free player. I've made a few purchases, but is still devastated by unbalanced mechs (looking at you zephyr). Overall it's a fun game, but hard to get by competitively without buying anything.

Pay to win game. The good mechs and weapons are behind a paywall. Almost all mechs and weapons should be purchasable with the main game currency. Rewards consist of a bunch of cards and not enough money, making upgrades impossible to catch up on. Popups will pester you all throughout your time on the game. This is not "necessary" to run a free game. People will still buy things without it being shoved in their faces.

the game is fun, and for the most part it's skill based. occasionally though you'll get matched with whales that wipe entire teams by themselves. the matchmaking seriously needs work. let the whales fight it out and the low spenders or f2p be in their own tier. aside from that the game is pretty solid. I have been having frequent crashes lately on my mobile though, not sure what that's about.

This is an awesome game with too many issues. Palarium is more interested in you playing on their platform to fix the issues. I have experienced way too many disconnects to be worth while playing. They advertise to you when you start the game and repeat every disconnect. The scaling in the game is bogus you earn too little in game currencies to keep up. So you either have to sandbag your teams to stay in a decent competitive game or get one shot by whales.

Used to be a good game but so PAY TO WIN just don't bother. Can't even win a game now unless you spend lots to get the latest insanely powerful weapon or robot. Even the bots are too powerful to play against! Used to be about skill and using the map but now just squad power. Even a new player can spend hundreds $ and beat those with many hours playing. Going the same way as War Robots. Steer clear of this game unless you're a masochist. 👎

It Is a very fun game That is both easy to learn and engaging. It was hard for me to put the game down except for the numerous ads in game. Really goes overboard on trying to get you to buy crates ,Upgrade your characters, or just spending in general. If there were not so many ADS every time that you come back To the Home Screen, I would have given it a 5 star rating. Ok, this is an edited review. After, what seems like changes were made, keeping players with similar skills, LOVE IT

Very entertaining played for over a year now. Of course, there is lots of development into new weapons and mechs all the time that's the money maker. As someone who doesn't like to pay for app games unless I feel I am getting something from it. I have bought a couple of items over the year. I wish more investment went into new maps as I am losing interest now.

The referral program is a scam. Had my brother install the game on his laptop only for Joel to inform us that for one reason or another, he can't count the referral. Edit after dev response: It was on a new device and the requirements were completed. Not like it matters, we both uninstalled the game. But potential players should be aware of the company's business practices.

It's a pretty fun game, but the prices for p2w players are simply outrageous. I'm sure there is a small minority that actually buy these deals though, so good for Plarium. I stopped playing after a few months as it felt extremely grindy without paying hundreds of dollars to speed things up. (Edit: That's a pretty clever reply. Hope your business model proves to be successful, and best of luck to you guys.)

Pretty fun, but a lot of grinding and super competitive. A lot of people pay to get good guns and mechs, and just house other people. For people who just want to enjoy the game can't really, it's either grind or die. Also a really cool thing they can do with the pilots is make a game/game mode like overwatch. Preferably fps, that would be sooo cool and I'd play every day. The pilots could be turned into something really cool other than a mech upgrade.

$$$$ Pay to win. Made a few purchases and everything available after has been incrementally more expensive. Also, when you purchase an upgrade, it's the base model, and needs upgrades (more $). Pay attention to what you think you are buying. You can play free but it takes forever to upgrade and be/stay competitive. Lots of ads. Team match up is often lop-sided. Friends list can be annoying with constant "recommended" list. Chat is very small font but Gameplay is fun, and very addictive.

Starts good at first, but later on in the game it will try to bully you into spending money by constantly putting you in extremely unfair battles with AI that are fitted with the highest teir mechs and weapons that cost 100s of dollars and will stomp you into the dirt. On top of that, newly added content to the game is usually locked behind $100 lootboxes

The game is enjoyable, but having to get out of 11 pop-ups every time I return to the hangar is borderline insane. Then having advertising that makes it nearly impossible to click the X, basically exiting you out and guess what....here's your 11 pop-ups again. Play a match, here's the exact same pop-ups. Change a weapon, here's your pop-ups. Yeah, fun, oh wait pop-ups again.

Edit 8-11-23 As much as I have loved playing this game, it's pay to win. Match making sucks. Go against a team with maxed out level 16 weapons etc. Just no way to compete. Pretty fun so far! So after playing this game for a while now, it's still fun. But this is a pay to win game unfortunately. So some games you get nothing but 1 shotted, so that sucks. You will find that you run into that problem often. Also, sometimes you get hit through barriers and walls.

Editing my review: in the beginning everything seems good. I do still like the game play, but having to close 15+ ads everytime I open the app and overly strict caps on XP and other things makes it significantly less fun.
