Game runs well, even on my mediocre phone, which is impressive considering the graphics are good. The controls are smooth and the gameplay is fun. The only thing preventing this from being 5 stars is the insane quantity of money you would have to spend to compete at high levels. There's plenty of fun to be had for f2p players but don't expect to stand up to wallet warriors any time soon.

This game is absolutely a good game! This is different from the other robot games! Other comments are all about "This is a pay-to-win game!" or "Poor Matchmaking!" but for me, it all depends on your experience, training and skills. I didn't spend money on it (even at the event of an exclusive Mech). I'm in Division 4, and mastered Lancer, the Weakest Mech. If you are going or playing already this game, trust me, I suffer too on my lose streaks but I learn a lot from it and I improved my skills..

Edit: Do not play this game. Its gambling mechanics and steady power creep will ensure that you are forced to spend in game resources, or real life currency, to maintain a proper balance of play, and will inevitably force you into endgame. There is no known technique nor play style to keep your current items and power level from becoming obsolete in the face of increasing difficulty, as Plarium has ensured that matchmaking remains a nuance to any and everyone wanting to play.

The game was fun for sure. However I had to uninstall because it isn't fun anymore. Having to exit 9 or 10 ads everytime you load up the game just to play. Followed by games disconnecting in the middle of play conistently now. Along with the absolute requirement of buying mechs and guns in order to play in tournament with out getting stomped. The cost to be able to play and have fun, along with the constant game crashing and the opening ads just make me no longer want to play.

It's a great game nice artwork and graphics, well-balanced team's. White a ton of fun and different mech's for your own game still where you really can see your progress. I really like all of the game modes. I especially like the future that all mech's have different atche ments to complete and white great rewards..! Really you have to give this game a Go it is awesome..! One more point I've recently lost my account and all of my progress and different mech's, but the support team was super TY!

I enjoyed it at first, but now it's very unbalanced and unfun. All the new guns and mechs are nice but the grind is way too slow to get there. You pay for them but its very expensive. It does get cheaper as you progress rank/level to getting them but by then you've suffered enough at the hands of others who paid for them to care anymore and by that point, they already have something better. To make it worse, EVERY MATCH YOU LOSE, YOU LOSE RANK, making it even harder to get there!

Fun game, but tiresome ads. Responsive third-person team shooter with a pleasing variety of weapons, mechs and arenas. Perfectly possible to enjoy playing for free, though progress starts to feel too slow after a while. No third party ads, but you have to close up to *seven* different pop-ups for the in-game shop *every time* you return to the main screen, and eventually that got too annoying and I quit.

This game is absolutely pay to win and every time you open it or go to the main lobby you get buried in pop ups trying to sell you stuff...but otherwise it's a super cool game! Sure you can play and unlock some things but some person is gonna just spend a dumb amount on a epic mech and or weapon and you stand zero chance...I generously gave it 3 stars because despite it being pay to win it can still be fun.

Very good game overall! Pay to win is a major issue once you hit division 1 though. Very strategic and has a little RPG aspect to it as well because you constantly upgrading your weapons and mechs, until you hit division 1. Everything then gets put behind either 2 months to a year of grinding, paying a ridiculous amount of money, or getting insanely lucky. Other than than that the gameplay is fantastic. Lots of fun to play. Also I feel they need a few more maps.

Saw the game reviewed 5 stars so I downloaded and play. Seems pretty good, I think it is manageable to completely not paying anything, my fav weapon is longarm 8 which u can get it by earning it. I usually killed many robots with higher lvl than me. I played War Robots and now they are getting worst as the matchmaking doesn't match well. One bad is, the effects and graffics doesn't like War Robots, which make it realistic, smoke from the guns etc. Overall pretty addictive game.

In game ads destroy the fun. Gameplay is good and challenging, but you spend more time dismissing ads for "pay to win" options that you get exhausted from the aggressive sales tactics. It's a strange balance of f2p and p2w. You can actually play the game as a free to play sometimes (as long as you dont run into the overpowered legendary mechs). But to get any of the many legendary items (the good stuff) you HAVE to pay money. Depending on the legendary item, it could be $5 or $40! Which imo is crazy. I would also be less upset if acoins (the in-game currency that is very important. Its like gems or something) were less scarce.

Mech Arena is actually really fun. Amazing idea and it came together really well, I highly recommend trying it out. My only problem with the game is that it is lowkey pay to win. You need in game currency for everything but you barely get any from playing so your only hope is events and money. Most of the legendary mechs cost money and if you can get them for free, you can still buy them early with money. I've spent around $25 on the game just to keep up with the competition. Good game overall.

Hacking is a lot better but now can you please sort out the server lag. I freeze half the time I'm fighting someone and get destroyed. Free kills for them and a very frustrating game for me. Is this freezing a hack? It seems to happen a lot on certain players?? Nope all good on my end your app is the only app it happens with and now I randomly lock onto players nowhere near me, I have uninstall.

This game is great, i dont have any problems with it other than the price of mech's and weapons are godlike amounts, im currently saving up for missile rack 8 and it just takes a lot of time, or is it, and also to spice up the game for a little bit, u should add a customize robot systems like, u can choose where to put weapon slots, choose the height of the robot, and have some different parts that can be in crates, tournament rewards and event rewards that can change looks and improove ur mech

Everything is amazing in this fast paced PvP arena. even tho it has pop ups they are still way better then constant ads, which you would find in any other good quality free game. overall best game I have played and the opportunities are endless, although it does take a little while to get to the higher tiers and the mechs are super expensive. plarium needs to do is drop tier stars for getting to next tier, and drop prices a little for mechs and weapons, it's too expensive to get good guns.

This game started off good. Been playing for months and it's just become more and more pay to win. They want you to be a "whale" and drop hundred, possibly even thousands, of dollars. They do this by assailing you with 6 to 10 "discounts" every time you log in, hoping you'll just give up on the ridiculous grind and drop the cash. Now, onto the grind...almost a year of playing and I can't compete with those that drop cash on this game. Last little thing...game is overrun with hackers/cheaters.

This used to be my go to game for relaxing, fun time away from work and family. Me time y'know. Now with all the focus on money based weapons and mechs instead of gaming experience, it's losing my loyalty. And with the newest releases it's introduced new glitches and problem during gameplay. Fixed the gameplay at least or you're going to lose another star. Maybe even another customer as well.

Changed my review a few times but this game deserves very little praise. Tried to enjoy it but progression is painfully slow unless you pay for weapons. And if you don't, expect those that have to dominate matches with 14+ kills. Only positive is casual play, but even then there are meta builds you just can't beat without making an entire load out specialized for them.

On the outside, this is a truly outstanding game, with excellent graphics and awesome gameplay, however there is a large imbalance between the people who pay to win. Despite the prices being way too high, some people spend hundreds on the best gear and resources to fully upgrade their weapons and in doing so become virtually unbeatable. Also another aspect that ruins the game for me is the guided class of weapons. They often kill you through no tactical skill because they can reach you from far.

Could easily be a 5 star game. Tons of fun. Very engaging. Borderline addictive lol. Main problem is the pay to progress format. I'm pretty good but I'm not paying to play. So I'm running around division 1 in the first mech against people who've dumped major money. Went from MVP to getting stomped. All my mechs, weapons and pilots can't be leveled further unless I pay. The gameplay for this game is very good and so are the graphics. Another good thing about this is there are no ads. Dropped to 2 star, was looking forward to buying rocket pads, to find I need 750+ a coins, this has curbed the rating, as it is to long to grind for things also, create a option for experienced players to remove purchase popups, 5* granted if you allow all weapons and mechs once unlocked to be purchasable with money, but for now, running around with 2 sets of weapons due to being op isnt real a fun experience, I hesitated to say it isnt pay2win, but I complete see that it is P2W, such a shame 2*

I don't leave reviews as much but there are some things that I do believe the game needs. 1. We need more communication options when in match. Add an option to mute shop notifications or make it so that they only ever pop-up once. I do understand that you as a game company need to generate revenue for your game. That is all, will change to 5 stars if these are addressed.

The game is really fun. That being said, it's pay to win. The best mechs/pilots/weapons are locked behind a paywall. Unfortunately, the matchmaking system doesn't account for this. You will reach a point where no amount of skill or teamwork can overcome the people who spend. 1 hit KO is common against the spenders, so you reach the point where you just don't want to play anymore. I love this game. Best war robot type game u can find and not so over the top pay to play. Sure there are some fanatics that go over the top but by buying only the monthly gold pass is worth it. They made some great updates to the game, only to come right back and mess it up. I tried leaving a comment on the forum, but it didn't let me, so I'll leave it here. The game is good, the mechanics and game play are easy to understand, the leveling and unlocking are balanced. Since its a game on a phone, it kinda limits the potential of the game. I'm looking forwards for the growth of this game and it's future, hopefully it would expand to the world of pc's. This game used to be great at first. Now the game looses connection in the middle of battles. Game was great in the beginning dont waste your time or money definitely a pay to play after you hit a certain point i played for 2 years then they started adding all these different mods and weapons that you almost had to pay for wasted 80 bucks on a "free" game bc i thought there was no way they would add more paid must have improvements. Poor and unbalance matchmaking, I'm a newbie to this game. After having fun a few rounds, that's when I experience cruelty of their game. Our team was one-shot destroyed by enemies from higher rank. This is so unfair. Why would anyone create this kind of matchmaking system? We are supposed to fight against enemies with same tiers. This game is not about skills, its also about money too. Unbelievable.

Rigged. The more you upgrade, the more rigged it gets. You've heard of pay to win, well this game is pay to lose. Each account has a predetermined win/loss ratio that can only be beat if you don't play with bots and have a full or close to full real player team. Bots have unfair advantages, can shoot through objects, randomly spawn on the map anywhere they want, they don't even have to aim at you to kill you, I've seen two bots just staring at each other not shooting until I show up. Stay away

I thoroughly enjoyed the game, and may come back. Yeah I bought a couple of the small packages, but it is definitely showing it is geared toward P2W, I mean 8-12 ads popping up every login, quest and events requiring a purchase to fully complete, the fun is still there I am just not gonna play at a disadvantage if I don't pay for the bigger ones. I am old school I would rather win or work for it.

Would rate it a 5 start bit I just find how adimant they are on making you purchase things. Whenever you login or finish a game about 8 ads pop up to purchase. Honestly it's a great game to play, if it loads! So far even though I have 5G and the best Wi-Fi I can possibly find nothing is loading at all... It won't put me into a battle or load any of it. Have been playing since 2021. The game is fun and energetic and the graphic is amazing. My comment may be a bit biased, but it is unfortunate that Mech arena is starting to become a play-to-win game. I had to admit I had spent quite a fortune on this game (300-500 USD). It's fun at first, but when you progress further it is nearly impossible to enjoy or win a match without paying anything. I remember I had buy and upgrade Redox and Railgun to win some matches. Hope the game is more affordable.

I downloaded the game because I thought "it keeps popping up for ads so I guess its good." but it was awesome, one of my new favorite games. you should definitely get this game. There are ads but its great.

It's a great game until you hit the pay wall. I would of purchased upgrades but it's massively overpriced and you will literally just not be able to upgrade mechs or weapons. Hours upon hours of play, evening after evening and the in-game rewards are so very numerous but will never amount to ANYTHING...!!!! Try it anyway as the first bit of play is very good

Lots of cool mechanics. It has taken the idea of robots with big weapons fighting from other games but revamped it with original robots, weapons, special abilities and colour schemes. The downsides of this game are that it is quite pay to win. You can unlock and max out most robots on the tech tree but you can just buy them for $25. Another problem is when you load up the game you are bombarded with pop up ads. It is also very laggy and glitchy in intense battles. Alright game. 6/10

I have yet to play it a lot but for now it's a pretty good game one complaint the characters movement and gunplay are a bit clunky and slow paced pls fix this 3 stars. the games is just so slow it gets kinda boring.

It's definitely a fun game, the gameplay is really great! However... The most pay-to-win game on the market. I had been pretty satisfied with how it operates until I hit the highest teir and then there was no point in even playing it was so infuriating. I give 3 stars, because of the game is so cool and fun also a lot of action. So please....fix the matchmaking. And keep up the good work

Cool game but i dont spend money on games so to get ahead i watch the sponsored videos. Why are the sponsored videos down?? You're losing money! This was the most addicting game I've ever played. I don't believe I've ever played against another human. That and all of the data harvesting is too peculiar for my comfort.

The game play is good. Some of the bad things are the game's server crashes all the time. Another thing is there are too many ads. Everything you open the game, you are hit with 8-10 ads. Sometimes the ads will pop up in the middle of the game. I understand you have to make money. However I suggest to make the ads one time daily instead of every log in Edit: After writing my review, the develops responded with a tone deaf message telling me to just skip through the ads fast. Disgusting

Too many "offers", too chaotic trying to keep on top of collecting your achievements and rewards, upgrades. I stopped playing War Robots because of all this, and I would rather go back to that. At least it took a while before they put you on losing teams to entice you to spend money to attempt to keep up. I want a WR style game that focuses on skill rather than trying to squeeze you into spending money right away. People will make purchases if it's a good game.

Like most mobile games, this one bombards you with pop ups every time you log on. Unlike most mobile games, there is no option to turn these off. Most games offer you a "do not display again" button. Wouldn't be a huge issue if not for the constant connection issues which force me to restart the game a lot. Dispite this, the game is really fun. I just wish it would quit shoving these "deals" down my throat.

Was enjoying but one major issue is all the pop ups for in app purchases. I just booted the game up and and had to close 8 freaking pop ups. Did one match and had to close 4 more. No ads in this game for external stuff, plenty for internal. Biggest issue I just realized is that this is a pay to win game. It's all online, nothing solo and they sell mechs and weapons for real money that are way better than anything you can earn in game. I will not be playing anymore. This had real potential..

You're game was a perfectly balanced, and overall friendly game. Sadly, this has changed over the few months I was gone. Chrome users, are left without a mouse cursor, and the game consistantly crashes the whole device when loading. I was hoping someone on the team would see this, and fix these minor issues. You had a great game, and I hope you can fix it.

Every time you open the main menu you get a minimum of 10 pop up ads to buy gear/equipment with small x buttons in the corner. Edit: the developer responded to this review. It would be great if the frequency of offers was reduced: 2 or 3 max. My concern is if i did purchase something, Id get even more pop-ups! I didn't want to buy the first 9 items, I certainly dont want the last one any more.

Fun game. The gameplay is fairly smooth, and the different weapons and mechs are fun to play with, but a few things make this game a three star. One, every time I go to the game lobby/main screen I am bombarded with "time limited deals" by the dozen, which is extremely annoying when I have to do it every single time. Second, personally, I find it absurd that we have to use the games premium (or harder to earn) currency to progress in the game, especially when tiering up the starter mech cost 75

Great game! But when I log on I hit a none stop 6 adds in my face(I culounted them). You have to 3xit out of each one of them, one by one!!! Game play seems to be weird at times. $1500 dollar phone, 5g, full bars. It's either lagging on the larger maps. Or something weird is going in game. Edit: Don't gaslight me, u don't need anything and you can't exit out of them very quick.

Experimented with a couple of these games but this one seems the most playable. Still trying to find a good way to move the turret without triggering other controls though. And the field of vision feels too low, as if you should be looking up more, because of terrain. But the control point matches are a lot of fun, and tactics help so it's more than just holding down the fire button. Many different rewards and nice graphics and sound design make it an enjoyable game.

It's fun... but, it takes forever to get a mech to the point for competence unless you do some major coin. The developers are in for the money. Period. You'll get smoked by overpowered BOTS, and they'll say they are working on it... then drop some new weapon for $40. I've been playing for a couple years so I was fortunate enough to build my mechanics before they got greedy... otherwise I wouldn't play this game again. I spend $10 a month for the Battlepass, and that's enough. It's what it is.

The controls are standard and easy to use, the graphics are just as good as you'd want them to, as u can customize the quality (higher quality can cause lag, so I use a lower level, but it still looks good.) The mechs are original and vary greatly, giving everybody a great variety of abilities and firepower between mechs. It is a wonderful game, and I highly recommend it to all gamers, serious or just as a passtime.

Effective and simple design for mechanical and weapons. Solid gameplay. My reason for uninstalling was the insane number of pop-ups. You can't play a match without seeing multiple pop-ups...every...single...time. The amount you need to pay for mech or blueprints just wasn't worth it. If they lowered the cost of the good stuff and cut the adds down tremendously a few people would consider coming back. For me, they would have to drastically change the cash system here.

I really enjoy the game, even with the "cash grabbing", but it needs to let up on the popups. You get like 10 of them every time you open the hanger. It can be really tedious to close them all. Other then that, the game has good graphics, runs very well, and the ability to equip two different guns is one of my favorites to work with! Just fix the the pop-ups and it would be a five star easily!

This game is a lot of fun with a decent variety of equipment to choose from. However, to put in the hard work to finally unlock gear the free way only to learn that you still have to pay just to equip it goes beyond me! The prices are simply ridiculous! What's more is you have to pay to upgrade the gear because they are base level!!! Don't get me started with the excessive ads that storm your screen and you haven't even started playing! Great Gameplay! Terribly annoying with In-App Purchases..

I love this game, I find it so enjoyable I've even spent money to try out new mechs and weapons. It is possible to play for free if you're patient, I've managed to get many upgrades without making purchases. However, the pop ups for in game purchases are ridiculous. In addition to this, I have noticed increasing lag during peak times which makes the game unplayable. I think it's time to upgrade the servers, guys. Your user's experience becomes more negative everyday you delay.

This game is pretty good I just wish there was a better way or a little quicker way to earn a coins. as I get higher in the divisions it's starting to seem impossible to get to the same weapons levels a the other players if you aren't able to spend 67 bucks on a gun, for example. There seems to be a bug that's been the deciding factor of winning matches or a fight that I've experienced many times in that the on-screen joystick bugs out and not allow movement and the firing button won't fire

The game is awesome overall, the quality, the maps, and the robots. I have been addicted to this game after playing it for a while. Far too Pay to Win, not free to play friendly. Unfortunately, given the high cost of literally any upgrade in the game, it's difficult to progress without breaking the bank. The amount of money needed to be spent on the game seems extortionistic at best, and is also urged onwards with the multitude of pop up offers that you get littered with in hopes you'll buy something. Gameplay is solid. I instantly enjoyed it as it felt pick up and play. Controls felt intuitive with a touch screen, and not overly cumbersome to use. the only issue, and this is one I have with any TPS or FPS, is the aiming to fire function. I feel this could be rectified with integrated controller support as an option to play with. I feel it's a bit on the nose to offer progression with experience to unlock mechs, only to then have them stuck behind a paywall of either months of gathering ingame credits, freemium credits or unless you're willing to shell out cash. Overall, my score is representative of the gameplay to cost level. The gameplay is very enjoyable, but it's held back by the cost involved. I would continue playing if it was free player friendly, and probably be more incentivized to pay for the season pass.

The prices on them are severely disproportionate, there are too many diffrent currencies and real world money cost for certain things are absolutely abysmal. I would love to spend money to support this game as I really enjoy it but I won't at those prices.

I would give only 3 stars because of two reasons. One: they mention that there is bluetooth controller support. But it's very buggy and you cannot use some buttons. Worse is you cannot change the settings on it. Two: the deals for purchases when you open the game is annoying and feels very pushy. I counted 13 pop ups for deals for purchase before I am taken to the main menu. That is too much pop ups. Otherwise it's a fun game even without using a controller.

I've played this game for quite some time. Some months ago a glitch occured where important graphics wouldn't load and all you'd see is a blank placeholder. In game they continue to develop and overwhelm you with ads for sales, but developers don't even give you a full interface you can see. Their response to bug reports give generic "we know about it" responses. There are too many other mech arena 'clones' out there that support their software. Good gameplay, great graphics, and I'd give them 5* if the company would take some of the money they are making and invest in better servers to handle the traffic then yeah. Next to making it literally impossible to get full potential of some rewards without spending money or giving you trash rewards even when u do spend the money! If those issues were addressed along with giving better incentives for joining a clan then I'd say a very well crafted detail oriented incredibly addictive game!

Game play is fun(when it's not glitching). Graphics are nice, You can report glitches, but if you don't have a video of the glitch it won't do any good. There is a great variety of mechs, weapons and pilots and they keep adding more. Problem is, if you're not willing to put in real $$$ then you are pretty limited on which mechs and weapons you can access and it takes a looooooong time to level up those mechs, weapons and pilots.

The game is very fun and the background soundtrack and sound effects are top-notch. What bothers me so much is the intrusive advertisements. Even Brawl Stars won't FORCE you to have to click through 10 different offer screens before reaching the Home screen. If I want to buy something, I'll head to the Shop. I don't need to see these ads. Customer service and devs have no clear evidence of communication and players have no confidence that devs have heard their requests. Core game is great though

I like the game a lot, but sadly I usually get kicked out the game, I usually play it at night where my signal reaches 2-3Mbps and I still get disconnected a lot especially in the middle of the game and ended up losing pts that I grinded earlier, It happens very often that I ended up losing from the match even if I reconnected in the game.
